review_text: Flew WAWLWOWAW last week The airport is very big and airy and clean No problems going through passport control either way and no issues with security The airport is quite empty but it has a duty free section some places to drink a coffee or have something to eat both inside and outside the departures so quite satisfactory With the huge fall of the Hryvnia the prices in the coffee shop are reasonable the gift shop Baltona is not a bargain as they quote in Euro Travelling to the city is about Hryvnia by taxi which is now about Euro There is free wifi that worked fine for me I would not hesitate to fly through Lviv again

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

Overall I like BHM Its small staff at least at Delta check in and gate are super friendly The amenities are good for a small regional airport Bags are usually quick to retrieve My one gripe is parking The parking deck is always almost very nearly completely full so finding a space can often take as long as the short flight to connect in ATL The one other thing that annoys me every time I do find a space is total lack of smart carts in the parking lots Hey listen up Airport managers This is an airport and customers travel with baggage Dont you think it would be a great idea to facilitate this process of getting bags to terminals by offering a cart service in the parking lots

Although it was busy Australia Day Public Holiday check in was quite easy The plane left on time and staff were efficient and friendly Only water coffee and tea is available for free but for a short flight I dont mind Overall a great flight and a pleasant way to end my Australia Day Break

I came from Bangkok to Doha and transited for hrs and then to my homeland Cairo I was frustrated to stay that long transit time but once i stayed there I enjoyed it so much The internet coverage and speed is awesome Perfect atmosphere perfect cleaning perfect toilets Unforgettable experience Thanks to each and everyone who participated at this huge well maintained entity

This is my second trip using this Airport This is a far superior experience when compared to the main international airport KLIA especially at the immigration Department The staff are friendly and helpful It took us less than minutes to clear immigration and custom The airport is clean and free wifi is provided I would highly recommend this airport if you are travelling within Malaysia or South East Asia

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

While I found the Jacksonville airport to be very clean with exceptionally friendly professional employees my review is regarding one in particular His name is Alejandro a wheelchair provider for people departing and arriving at the airport I first met him on October when I arrived at JAX He was prompt friendly and a very nice person Well when I left JAX I ran into Alejandro again and he recognized me after a week and all the people hed met He was so pleasant I have required wheelchair assistance when traveling for over years and Alejandro is hands down the best

I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed this airline experience From the check in counter to the TSA at the local tiny airport to the pilots It is totally a different way of flying commercial and just so much more personal I wish more routes were like this because its such a nice experience My flight was also minutes early on arrival which allowed me to get to my next gate with ease Thank you Boutique Air and hope to fly you again some day Maybe there will be wifi next time

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

This was my first flight with Jazz and all in all I was quite pleased The flight to Montreal was short and agreeable The crew spoked both French and English which makes a plus for the flight To my surprise the economy seats were equipped with personal IFE with the whole Air Canada inflight program Food consisted of a cookie and a drink which is more than enough for a one hour flight The only downside of the flight was the delay created by bad luck The aircraft was already late already and during taxi when we were about to align on the runway the tower decided to change of runway making us hour late On our arrival at Trudeau the crew make sure that the passengers going on another flight about to depart left the aircraft first
Flying from Chiang Mai to Bangkok regularly I find Orient Thai very punctual friendly and the best value available without question

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station
I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and helpful Only water coffee and tea were complimentary which is no issue on such a short flight

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

TLLAMS a busy morning flight on the perennially cramped CRJ Compared to my last flight with Estonian a year ago the service much better and Tallinn airport keeps improving and is now probably the nicest small airport in Europe clean free wifi comfy seats and even a library No service whatsoever on Estonian Air which besides being governmentowned is on par with Ryanair for what it offers But as a way to get from Point A to Point B its acceptable

This airport has excellent free wifi but lacks any decent shops or restaurants I stayed in the airport for hrs whilst waiting for a connecting flight The checkin agent wouldnt check my bag through so I was stuck at the airport The best area for wifi is on the nd floor There are powerpoints behind the bench seats for charging your laptop Airside there are small shops and a cafebar at the very end of the departure lounge where the wifi doesnt work As a capital city airport it is lacking in many of the things one would expect Without the wifi it would be very hard to pass the time waiting for connecting flights

Outstanding views when arriving in on a fair weather day Pass through Airport in little time due to size of airport Friendly staff and facilities need to step up with any increase in flightpassenger numbers Sligo City is only miles form the airport or Euro taxi Journey Area beside airport is popular for running golf surfing and sea sports with international surf competitions held regularly

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Baku to Kiev with Buta Airways I have to say after travelling for years this was definitely the best Low Cost Carrier I have ever flown with On time and sharp Plus you get free water and a free sandwich But saying that for a ml beer is and a pizza Incredible value you money I had flown them for a min flight so was interested to see what a hour flight would be like But it was absolutely perfect

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

Check in at LHR T was quick and easy and minimal queue for security Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight Malaysia use A for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good The meal service starts with signature satays followed by smoked salmon for the main course I tried the Malaccanstyle seabass fillet very tasty An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the inflight entertainment the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates Flight arrival into KL was minutes ahead of schedule which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok but can get very busy Our onward flight to Penang was on an B one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system which you use with your own device We did not use this for such a short flight We were impressed with the service on this minute flight which included a small hot meal Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines
What a delightful surprise The best service good food excellent entertainment Very spacious seating Very good price for the ticket Its my new favourite airline I will seek it out in future for sure

I arrived in Nur Sultan Airport from Novosibirsk Russia and left to go to Almaty The Immigration control was quite fast and no problems in getting a day Visa on arrival The airport is relatively new and modern Security was efficient and effective I had a couple of hours between flights and wanted to recharge phone and computer There was plenty of seating but there were very few places and none adjacent to a seat where I could charge my computer I watched it from about metres away The airport has all the things that interest some people money exchange tourist souvenirs etc I seldom shop in airports

My husband and I have never used Newcastle airport before but I though we would give it ago and this time I need special assistance as Im waiting for spinal surgery and loosing the use of my hands and feet I booked it easily enough with Ryanair and the special assistance was easy to find and I found the staff very kind and courteous and nothing was too much trouble We arrived the hours before we travelled as per the warning message from Ryanair so the special assistance man took us through the process of Xray and boarding cards so easily and left us for a drink and they came back when they said for me and everything was perfect except the food area was slightly dirty but the special assistance people all I can say thank you for making my travel easy and you all were brilliant

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

What a lovely little airport the whole experience seemed organised with little to no queuing areas as passengers seemed to just self manage to the different areas of the airport From check in to departure the airport was very clean with little wrong on this front I found myself very impressed with the smiling security team as I went through pre security and main search area as well Arrivals was good as well with clean arrivals area straight from the plane I was really impressed with this airport when comparing to some of the UK airports it has a much higher standard Wifi runs on a free voucher system which worked a treat very easy with no need to sign up Shopping is not great as there is just a duty free shop and FB is limited and expensive Overall a very good airport

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism
Beautiful new terminal with excellent check in security and facilities very impressed

I arrived today from Heho with a sick child probably from food poisoning and was helped like I never thought I could We were taken charge of by a great team of officers nurse doctor that took us to the airport clinic and took care of my daughter Everyone has been great and we are really grateful to each of you They will recognize themselves

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes

This is a lovely little regional airport barely minutes from Tours It took just a few minutes to clear immigration then off to the car rental office which is in a hut outside the terminal building in the car park Be warned that car rental here is scandalously expensive It cost over for days Anyway on my return I went to the small caf before security which offers a small but tasty range of snacks and drinks at reasonable prices Clearing security took a couple of minutes and boarding was a breeze All in all just how air travel should be in an ideal world

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

Ms Terri V who was the boarding agent for my flight provided phenomenal customer service when it was needed most When I realized that my lay over time from my connecting flight to my final destination was tight she was able to move me up four rows with no extra charge She was friendly patient and wanted to do what was right for the customer given my situation when many others may have not cared as much She is someone other boarding and TSA agents should emulate not just here in San Antonio but around other airports as well

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

A very small airport but well run It has stands which are all a few steps from the terminal building It is no where near Oslo miles south approx hours away The terminal building is a single storey with Checkin Desks on one side arrivals in the middle with belt and Security Scanning on the other side On the Land Side there is a cafshop supplying hot and cold snacks and other things and a seating area It is very small so everything is within easy reach but if more than plane is in at a time it could get busy Outside there is lots of car parking and car rental options along with transport to the local railway station for trains to various points including Oslo If you are visiting Oslo City Centre think carefully before using this airport if you want to access the locality it is a small friendly place

Albrook Panama City to Bocas del Toro After reading comments about this airline I was a bit worried but our flight with Air Panama was really okay Checkin at the airport was quick there were no lines My bag was kg so I had to pay dollars for the kg overweight Totally fine There are no infoscreens at the small airport of Albrook but as there are only leaving a couple of flights a day its obvious when boarding starts The flight left at so right on time The fokker used for this flight is old but seatpitch was okay for this minute flight to Bocas After a loud and bumpy take off the crew handed out some crisps and a soda After minutes of cruising with some wonderful views at the rainforest and Caribbean beaches the pilot started decent into Bocas airport After a soft landing and a short taxi to the small apron our luggage appeared within minutes We really enjoyed this flight in this old air Panama fokkerairplane

I recently flew with Alaska and had the best service Comfortable seats wifi and connectivity was excellent there was no entertainment screen but I was able to watch movies on my laptop and the choices were excellent Food was excellent cabin was clean landingdeparture was on time and relaxing the flight was on time value for money was awesome ground service was awesome I had a fabulous experience with Alaska airlines and will fly with them again

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

Benghasi Domestic to Tripoli Domestic What a nice surprise Buraq Air is the year old private airline in Libya that operates domestically as well as to Cairo and Istanbul It is the vastly preferred carrier to Libyan Arab Airlines My flight from Benghasi domestic to Tripoli domestic was easy to purchase in town not on Sabre or Galilleo unfortunately and was just one way The domestic airport is nothing to write home about but is clean and Benghasians are very friendly with smiles all round This flight operated with a rather longinthetooth you know the ones with long cigarshaped engines but was clean and the cabin crew were polite engaging and presented themselves in smart uniforms smiles all round again This was an all economy configuration but legroom was more than European airlines in J class Soft drinks hot drinks and some cakes made a break during the minute flight

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

The cabin was too warm which made this short flight rather uncomfortable also it was a rather turbulent one They served a good sandwich with complimentary drinks which in my opinion is a very nice gesture Legroom was premium as were the seats

Bragana to Cascais with Aero VIP Seven Air provides the services The pilot was very nice and made sure everyone was comfortable and explained there would be some turbulence which was normal Flight arrived minutes late

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

Each time I have flown in and out it has been easy The lines moves quickly and everyone is friendly and helpful Upon arrival after passing through immigration you proceed to the baggage carousel and hope that your luggage has made it to your destination with you but dont try to walk away with your suitcase that easily someone will be standing by to check your baggage tag and your passport

I wouldnt want to be a cheerleader for Ryanair So many things can go wrong But when things go right as they did on this trip I think it should be said that the airline provides a good service at a reasonable cost Most of the annoying announcements have gone and by paying a few pounds extra you can get a seat up front and take an extra bag on board The cabin crew were efficient and friendly particularly on the return flight where they were smiling and looked happy to be there

Flew this route again last weekend Menzies the handling agent at EDI very helpful bag drop and boarding a breeze Where SunExpress excel is with their cabin crew who were helpful friendly and professional Also very well groomed Bugra and Ismet were excellent and an asset to the company I wouldnt hesitate to travel with them again and recommend

I very much enjoyed flying with SAS Very attentive and cheerful staff ontime departures and landings free coffee and tea service incl refill clean and modern planes A delightful experience My only little complaint is the ticket fare but after all it was in highseason and ok for such a good service

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

I have to say this is the best airport I have ever used so straight forward and friendly helpful staff all the way Plenty of shops to have a stroll around and fantastic food Only an hour away from home with great parking I am sure this is my airport of choice from now on Absolutely love it great start to our holiday Thank you Doncaster Sheffield airport

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security

My Husband and I traveled on American Airlines Flight AA to New York from Florida We were extremely pleased traveling home on this plane This was mainly due to Flight Attendant DeJon DeJon made sure we were comfortable asked us what drinks we wanted and served us snacks and a very nice lunch Mostly he was so congenial and I could see he was working so hard taking care of the passengers My Husband and I are seniors and I can honestly say that we very much appreciated DeJon It made our flight enjoyable and we were glad we flew with American Airlines

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

The airport is very small and virtually all of its flights are internal Swedish flights Firstly the airport doesnt open until am on Sundays if you show up earlier you will be waiting outside until it does which in winter in Sweden will not be much fun Secondly the first shuttle bus from Stockholm city centre to Bromma doesnt leave Stockholm until am on Sunday and it takes about minutes By contrast shuttle buses to Arlanda leave every minutes all day These factors are well worth bearing in mind for arrivingdeparting Bromma The lounge is also closed on Sundays The airport has a small selection of coffees and cakes and a very small and not particularly extensive souvenir shop possibly because the primary users are Swedish people on internal flights

Quito is a really nice new airport about km from the city there is very little available around it The airport has free wifi which is always a bonus As it seems with all airports now the prices of small things like coffee etc are expensive My experience with the new airport was excellent not so though with the employees of American Airlines at Quito Airport beware

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

Im a native Sudanese born and raised in Sudan who travels a lot around the World Whenever I visit my beloved Sudan I always feel sad twice The first time is when I arrive at KRT Arrival Terminal This terminal was opened in It was as it is now small with two halls handling maximum of two airplanes at any time But it was nice clean artfully designed and the staff members seemed to be happy working there Unfortunately since then nothing has changed improved or fixed as in some cases and its been getting worse and worse every time I see it The second time I feel sad is when I leave Sudan Not only because Im leaving home but because of the waiting battle at KRT Departure Terminal where bureaucracy is at its highest level This terminal was born more than sixty years ago and never raised Its still small and always seemed very crowded even with one airplane passengers You always have to have extra money with you for the unannounced new fees or stamps Sudan has just signed a peace accord ending more than years of civil war in the South The oil money has started fueling the economy and a new state of art airport is being planned in the east side of the River Nile in Omdurman Hopefully this new airport will be opened soon Theres more than ten millions Sudanese who leave outside Sudan And always willing to visit their family no matter what sometimes twice a year The great generous and passionate people of Sudan deserve much more than what they have now

Munich to Bologna and Pisa to Munich both on an Embraer economy Both flights handled efficiently southbound on time northbound delayed by about mins on departure due to to late arrival of incoming flight there had been thick fog at MUC early that morning which had sent things adrift for much of the morning However support given to those with tight connections Modest inflight service snacks and drinks wine came in proper glasses Air Dolomiti worked okay for us
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

Was feeling travel sick after arriving Abu Dhabi airport and while waiting for my next flight Starbucks staff were very helpful and called the medic for me and were very helpful Helped me recover within hour Lovely staff

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

Our flight from Dusseldorf to Paris came in late Boarding went fast and according to our onward tickets in Premium Economy we had SkyPriority status Airportstaff in Dsseldorf was great professional and well informed about the connecting time in CDG The flight was without any specials Friendly crewmembers and a nice plane I havent expected a snack on this short flight but CoffeeTea and a Croissant served right after take off Seats on this plane offering enough legspace A good flight with HOP

Dusseldorf to London City Very nice flight including free Snacks and drinks Legroom was okay and staff was friendly but seemed a little stressed due to a huge amount of hand luggage in this flight Inflight magazines were old

Great Airport We travelled from Manchester and from landing to leaving the airport it only took us minutes For the return flight we checked our bags in minutes and took just another to get through security etc The departure lounge is bright and welcoming and boarding just took a few minutes Good experience I wish more airports were like this

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

I fly in and out of here regularly and am very impressed For a small airport TSA is efficient and does not do a lot of unnecessary screening just to have something to do as at other small airports The gate crews work very hard to get you out ontime and luggage retrieval is easy Rental car offices are next to baggage claim and other than Budget are extremely helpful There is a coffee shop upstairs as well as a barrestaurant everyone is friendly here and pricing is reasonable Two minutes from I The place seems pleasantly ignorant of airport hassles that have descended upon much of the industry

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

Our flight from Murica to Bournemouth was cancelled and the holiday was a disaster but the staff at Bournemouth were so helpful they kept me up to date with information they sorted all the car parking out and made sure we all made it home without any major issues The thing was no matter how many people say about the drop off fee of so what for a local airport min drive parking min walk to the building nice and calm and relaxing food was amazing now they have costa so what else would you need

Oldest airport that is still in use but great The mother of all airports has an impressive architecture huge size and is very close to the city Unfortunately SN Brussels airlines is the only largest airline flying there together with some local airlines Unfortunately they want to close it in the next years but the building will not be destroyed

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

Domestic h flight from Ulaanbaatar to Dalandzadgad in South Mongolia on Hunnu Air in July Checkin and security clearance at the old ULN Chengis Khan Airport reasonably swift Departure and arrival on time Very pleasantly appointed ATR in good state of repair Friendly flight attendants Coffee water snacks All announcements in Mongolian and Russian I guess Cabin crew also speaks no English

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

BudapestVenice Marco Polo Malev put me on this Moldavian Airlines flight without warning of a code share Proved to be a fairly pleasant flight in the end Food consisted of a chocolate bar and a glass of Hungarian red wine On the way back the flight was a little late arriving and they clearly rushed everyone on without having time to clean up The connection between Malev and Moldavian airlines is confusing The pilot thanked us for flying with Malev but the stewardesses were in Moldavian uniforms and the plane was clearly Moldavian
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

New airport building opened in August Large and airy construction gives a positive feeling to airport experience International Arrivals involve a bit of walking to the Baggage Reclaim and International Arrivals which happen on the ground floor Car Rental Caf and Bureau de Change all within the terminal building Bus Taxi and Tram are out by the front door Undercover walkways connect to short stay car parks Departures are on the st floor with the usual automated checkin Security pretty quick with more capacity when things get busy The Departure Lounge overlooks the end of the runway and has air bridges to most departure gates some bus departures for small aircraft parked remotely Good selection of shops and cafes A big improvement on the old terminal building

We had an absolutely delightful experience with Privilege Style The staff were very nice and accommodating Seating was exactly as expected and food was fine enough for a flight meal Thank you for a great experience We look forward to flying Privilege again

Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre

BOGMZLBOG I took them from Bogota to Manizales when I was visiting Colombia in December The crew was fantastic airport staff was polite The planes were new comfortable and service was great Tickets were very reasonable but book them early through the website to take advantage of the promotional fares which could equal US round trip depending on where you are going and how early you book

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

Monday th April what an absolute disgrace hours to get through security after being told minutes lifts out of order another reserved for staff when you escaped the great long queues conveyor belts working out of very little staff available On return hour wait for luggage an absolute disgrace A final comment I will never use Birmingham again and yet only minutes from home and have used this airports many many times and many times had problems but no more East Midlands much better

ODSIEV on a new ATR having small screens for the safe announcements and you can see some comics during the hour minutes flight Flight was full but service was ok they offered refreshment Staff were very friendly and we were on time Overall very nice experience

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

My experience was very smooth no flight changes or surprises in the departure flight In the arrival flight there was a security threat in Beirut Airport resulting in flight delays for ALL airlines The way Ajet dealt with the situation was outstanding and professional Given the unintended delays we missed the next flight Without even asking and as soon as we arrived to their desk they fixed the flight for the next day and offered us free transport hotel and meals The air and ground crew is very nice and helpful The only setback is in communicating with the Airport employees in English Until this improves communicate with a smile and nice attitude and youll get what you want eventually

Mykonos to Thessaloniki A short super enjoyable flight Everything went well on both flights the planes were nice and clean crew presentable professional and helpful and the flights on time short and so enjoyable I kept looking through the windows at the islands we were flying over beautiful Both flights were under minutes long we even got a small bottle of water coffee a cookie and a wet towel I can totally recommend Ellinair

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade

I had a problem with the immigration I somehow missed the immigration check after my evening flight from Hanoi to Luang Prabang my responsibility of not having checked if I had a stamp The next day I went back and they charged me on top of what I already paid made me sign a paper written in Laos not a copy or a picture I was able to take after I asked I paid as there were no other option They were not nasty but not kind they kept telling me its my fault for not checking No sharing the responsibility or acknowledged that they might have not done a proper job on their hands So check your stamps before you leave there are different separate lines to do one for the visa the other for the immigration stamp and be aware that they can play the game they want At the end all is good you pay and you have your passport back with a big smile from their side

Minsk to Gatwick The airport in Minsk looks like it has been renovated recently and it was modern and efficient Boarding was slightly delayed but we got to Gatwick on time The aeroplane was fairly comfortable and you get a bit more room in an Embraer which has a x seating configuration The food and beverages were quite good and the aeroplane had some cool branding featuring a tankbased computer game that was developed in Belarus Cabin crew were a little gruff and could have been warmer and more welcoming but overall its a decent product and good value for money

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and professional The seat was very comfortable The meal was tasty with a very good wine Although the flight was short I would have preferred a more substantial meal Otherwise a very pleasant start to my vacation

Flew Bangkok to Paro roundtrip both flights via Calcutta Outbound I was in Economy Plus and the legroom was excellent The breakfast was well served hot and tastyfar more substantial that is offered on many other carriers On the return I was upgraded to business and the leather seat was roomy and comfortable The meal lunch was good but the performance of the crew was truly worldclass I have to say that I was very impressed by the professionalism and demeanour they displayed In business one is given access to priority clearance in Bangkok which worked well but still a long wait for baggagethough mine was the first bag out Excellent offering overall

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

San Francisco to Indianapolis I was on my last leg of journey home from New Zealand I flew out with American an then Fiji Air New Zealand Jetstar in New Zealand and they were all great The staff on Virgin America need to fly with these airlines and learn how to smile be friendly and not look grouchy A smile goes a long way

I fly this route regularly but usually in Economy as this was a busy weekend there were no economy tickets remaining so I booked BusinessClub Europe I never deal with checkin as Im always hand luggage only I headed straight into the airport and decided Id try out the OneWorld lounge at Schiphol as this was included There was a huge queue with people being turned away from the Lounge front desk this however turned out to be for another providers lounge I checked with the front desk and was allowed to enter the OneWorld lounge This lounge was nicely furnished with plenty of food and snacks available nice quiet restrooms within the lounge were also available This space was a welcome change from the hustle and bustle from the rest of the terminal and I relaxed here for a while before my flight The staff were very friendly and attentive When boarding time came I made my way to the gate of course passengers ignored the boarding order and all just crowded the gate this left multiple priority boarding passengers unable to board until most of economy had seated Schiphols ground staff need to be more organised in this respect On the plane as this is only a seating layout the seating was no different to economy I expected this and the Embraers are quiet spacious despite being smaller planes Our food and drinks orders were taken before take off so the dedicated ClubWorld staff could serve as soon as possible on the short flight Food was a cold dish but was a very tasty Asian style chicken and slaw various other snacks were included and I had glasses of champagne because why not Staff were very friendly and attentive despite how short this flight was Arriving at London City was like it is in any class quick and simple Overall the experience was good and for the difference in cost in Avios points I will now be doing this journey in ClubWorld rather than Economy in the future
The airport staff was helpful polite and respectful There was a metro which helped me move around quickly Schedule boards everywhere Nice restaurants and coffee shops Not crowded at all

Excellent both coming and going Good selection of shops and restaurants Layout easy to navigate Well signposted in both Spanish and English Clean throughout Ample restroom facilities Best of all the passportcustoms control personnel both incoming and outgoing are courteous efficient and multilingual They smile I hope they can give US officers the basic lesson Corners of mouth go up not down
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

OsloCopenhagen th Aug on a B Oslo Airport is shamelessly very pricey Timely arrived minutes prior to schedule smooth flight Easy superfast checkin in Oslo Granted nice soft roomy seats and a full row of loads of space Flight only half full Catering onboard good though only at hefty costs Ticket inexpensive No IFE WiFi or frills But no complaints the price does not allow for much complaints Boardingdeboarding very quick through jetbridges Aircraft and FAs were somehow aged but all worked effectively

This is really a different airline The plane was impeccable clean looked young Cabin staff is really amazing taking care and checking during the hole flight Food was exquisite The Samsonite amenity kit was amazing sleek and modern A real pleasure to travel on this airline

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

Had a flight from Gatwick to Zakynthos with Grand Cru Airlines as Small Planet had an issue with one of there aircraft The staff were stunning and so friendly The aircraft was one of the best with very good comfy seating Thank you for getting our holiday off to a good start Would fly with Grand Cru Airlines any time

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

I just booked through this airport in October on my way to Australia It was such a dream no queues friendly efficient staff Luggage scanned without having to remove Ipad small bottles etc It must be one of the better airports in the EU

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

The Airport is actually very nice and there are many comfy sofa beds It has a good amount of shops and places to eat and it has a clean and comfy atmosphere The airline Gulf Air was a nightmare but the airport was very good Recommended to transit through

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

We were running late due to heavy unpredicted traffic in Ayodhya It was a surprise to see even the airport route was blocked We drive to airport and called Akasa Airlines and they helped us to wait for few min Many thanks to ground staff where they waited for us and helped us to get in faster Akasa accommodated my request and waited for me for boarding Really appreciated the efforts

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

I traveled into and out of Cardiff Airport in June I found the airport to be quite user friendly and compared to some of the reports Ive read a pleasant surprise A couple of negatives the one pound coins needed for the baggage trolleys seems rather tight and petty Although its close to Cardiff and the M it isnt easy to get to and from unless you have a car Even in a car there seem endless roundabouts and traffic lights to get through Check in was fine I arrived in plenty of time The security on departure seems over zealous compared to say Heathrow and would if the Airport were busier lead to very long queues The shopping was okay toilets were adequate seating in the new departure lounge was fine I didnt try the food outlets or WiFi As I said at the start not an amazing airport but it did the job it is after all a small regional airport

A very friendly team of staff overall at Memphis Airport Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

What a wonderful feeling entering the Bermuda airport Friendly thoughtful staff and the wonderful band playing Bermuda is Another World were quite the contrast to American and Canadian airport experiences My wife and I just returned from a wonderful stay in Bermuda if possible tell the band that their beautiful music is still in our heads a week later

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

This was the busiest I had ever seen Sydney Airport but things ran smoothly the staff were very efficient getting everyone through security and was very impressed to how friendly the security staff were that is really appreciated I was also impressed when my flight with Air New Zealand was ready to board they called the Business class passengers first and policed it by checking everyones boarding pass which is good as one pays a lot more money for Business Class so should have the privilege When departing Auckland it wasnt policed hence so many more people were in the line An impressive airport overall

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot
