This is a nice and modern airport at the moment they are expanding the airport so there is a lot of building going on but in the departure area you will not notice this very much The Airport has got free Wifi and a small restaurant with shop on the land side Airside you will find a small shop with prepacked sandwiches and hot dogs and other small stuff a small duty free shop is also around but not very cheap There is no Lounge to be found at the moment but after the expansion is completed there will be one available around May Checkin procedures are fast and the waiting area after checkin is fine with a view on the tarmac All in all a nice modern but small airport with expensive restaurants and shop

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

Flying Izmir to Ercan The International section is Very clean and modern Quick and efficient passenger service from checkin through passport control and all the way to boarding Its always a pleasure to use Izmir Adnan Menderes airport for arrivals and departures internationally The duty free shops are spacious and have many shopping options The toilets are clean and stocked I have no complaints always hasslefree flying out and through Izmir The WiFi is also a bonus very fast and user friendly to access

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

My flight had been delayed so I arrived later at the airport however checkin had closed as checkin times had not been amended The security team were really helpful in scanning my bike box and ensuring it got to the gate to be loaded on the plane The team were very friendly and supportive with a great result Thanks
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

I flew China Airlines from Singapore to Vancouver on the st June by Premier Economy The flight was not very full but dep from Singapore again delayed by minutes Due to this the Airline allows another extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector the Dinner was below par only the fine quality basmati rice north indian tasting veg fruits was edibleI would rate this only The breakfast second meal was better as they provided Parotta with Indian cauliflower potato curry cabbage curryboth tasty Again fruits were provided Banana should have been given I would rate this meal No Plain Yoghurt an essential part of every Indian Veg meal was provided Fortunately I always carry my own Yoghurt Indian Pickle packets so I could repair the meals enjoy them I hope China Airlines pays attention to my comments modifies their AVML meals to include more Yoghurt Indian breads in future The Seat was very comfortable with seating in Premier Economy Baggage was well handled no damages was quickly discharged at Vancouver Airport Overall view of China Airlines the Flight can be described as relaxed comfortable with good service ambience A last word on the A Aircraft which in my view is excellent for such a long flight smooth stable very spacious I will continue to fly by China Airlines in my future flights to Asia

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

It was first time at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport it was is one of the nicest and biggest airports I have come through in the USA anywhere in the world This multi level airport has many boarding bridges There are many shops and restaurants The staff were friendly and welcoming The airport is welldecorated and wellmaintained and easy to get in or out Public areas are a huge clean and bright

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Vladivostok is a fairly modern airport built in the last years it has lots of space for check in and a decent departure area There is one major problem though there is limited foreigh language support if you are a non Russian speaker If you have problems with your baggage all the forms are written in Russian with no translation all the support staff only speak Russian The people at check in have limited English language skills enough to check people in but I estimate of staff in the airport only speak Russian If you dont have any issues when you fly into or out of Vladivostok then it is a nice airport to travel through but if you do have any problems it can be a nightmare to try to find any people willing to help you they just dont care if you have an issue
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well

Airlink do so much right and so many other carriers in the region can learn from them Reliably on time on time across all their flights into Joburg for example great convenient connections through OR Tambo Johannesburg for regional Southern Africa departures onto domestic SA ones generous baggage allowance kg per passenger from Lusaka to SA ever smiling welcoming cabin crew and checkin staff on sectors without exception coupled with tasty cold meals on intl sectors and good South African wines and juices on all really help them to stand out alongside now even a loyalty rewards program Keep doing what you do Airlink we are so grateful and you will be rewarded with custom

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Shenyang airport traffic is not very convenient only airport buses and trams especially few flights no subway After entering the terminal the design is more atmospheric Except for China Southern Airlines other airlines can only check in minutes in advance which is not good In addition there are few automatic checkin machines so the queue at the manual checkin place is serious Security is fast and funny There are a lot of rest areas and mobile phone charging areas after security check WiFi is fast The fly in the ointment is that there are a few restaurants In addition there are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the luggage will arrive soon The guidance signs are perfect

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

London City to Paris Orly I arrived just over one hour prior to my flight and proceeded to checkin Whilst the queues were not long it did take at least minutes due to the multitude of bags of some passengers Boarding was orderly and we left on time The E has a lot of legroom compared to other BA cabins though the cabin has started to look a bit dated with older seats and torn magazines The onboard service was appreciated though it was not exceptional The service was somewhat lethargic but they were attentive After about minutes we began our descent into Orly Overall it was a great flight and if you live somewhat closely to LCY I would recommend CityFlyer over the regular BA service exLHR

I traveled into and out of Cardiff Airport in June I found the airport to be quite user friendly and compared to some of the reports Ive read a pleasant surprise A couple of negatives the one pound coins needed for the baggage trolleys seems rather tight and petty Although its close to Cardiff and the M it isnt easy to get to and from unless you have a car Even in a car there seem endless roundabouts and traffic lights to get through Check in was fine I arrived in plenty of time The security on departure seems over zealous compared to say Heathrow and would if the Airport were busier lead to very long queues The shopping was okay toilets were adequate seating in the new departure lounge was fine I didnt try the food outlets or WiFi As I said at the start not an amazing airport but it did the job it is after all a small regional airport

There are terminals terminal A for most domestic flights Garuda Indonesia Lion Air Wings Air Citilink and terminal B for international flights and other domestic flights Sriwijaya Air NAM Air Air Asia and Express Air Terminal B is smaller than Terminal A but the facilities are quite good The security staff and ground staff are good There are some shops that sell food and drink with reasonable prices There are also some toilets and ATM for the passengers Some minor issues are the lack of electrical socket for charging your gadget The seat in the waiting room is adequate in quality and quantity There are some traditional Javanese ornament in the airport

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every minutes JR train connections minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Bangkok to Yangon retjurn in midMay This is my first experience with this airline and it did not disappoint The checkin at the airport for both flights were uneventful efficiently handled and most notably having little or no queues which is always a welcomed sight when there are snaking queues at neighbouring counters for other airlines The boarding for the outgoing flight started a little after the scheduled time The planes do not have any seatback entertainment units but for the outgoing flight there was onboard wifi which allow you free access to a selection of movies and TV shows on the MAI app which can be preloaded onto phones Ipads etc The selection was limited For a min flight it is impressive that the cabin crew is able to come round with wet tissues followed by a meal and drinks service The cabin crew were polite and cheerful The captain made announcements regularly which were spoken in clear English

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

Being fed up with the chaos at many ports of entry into the USA from Europe as a non USAcitizen I thought to try out a new way to enter the USA with less wait hassle stress and frustration I flew the nonstop AA flight from LHR into RDU Even though I was in business class and was among the first to disembark I believe all passengers entered the USA border control in minutes or less It took me minutes from plane door to curbside Also the airport is modern and clean really nice staff With just one or two daily incoming flights from Europe I dont think there is a better way to travel into the USA from Europe I connected the next morning on a very early am departure Staff told me there was a morning rush so I was a bit nervous about TSA opening only at am Arrived at am and soon after that TSA started processing passengers Again lovely kind people all around What an exceptional airport

Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

Hong Hong to Budapest via Shanghai Flew on A on HKG to Shanghai while in a newer B on the long haul to Budapest China Eastern marketed flights The long haul leg was flown by their daughter company Shanghai Airlines to Budapest Amazing experience pure adventure Bought this ticket some months earlier for the high season to Europe as a huge bargain for USD including x kg of luggage which is welcomed near Xmas It costed me in addition positioning and depositioning flights to which I volunteered as I needed the extra miles for my elite status However I was notified months before travel by my online travel agent Travelgenio that the return flight from Budapest was preponed by hour Then I was forced to change as I would not be able to arrive in time for the new departure I then decided to change plans completely and celebrate New Year in Budapest instead of Vietnam Thus I postponed my return travel from Budapest by days This was done by emails to the Travel Agent no response and then phone calls to Ch Eastern in Brisbane and Shanghai Eventually it went smoothly and I was changed to my wish without added costs apart from changing onward flights beyond Hong Kong with another airline That even allowed me to do another cheap detour to Hanoi on my way back to Hue The homepages of China Eastern and Shanghai are difficult to penetrate and to book or change bookings from Unless one has a Chinese telephone number However days before departure I could access seating and chose freely my favourite seats even got of legs in exit seat However one cannot access the entire booking unless registered with CEs flyer program in which I am not interested Apart from that it was a good adventure a complicated travel where everything could have gone wrong but all went smooth Arrived in Hongkong early and was able to checkin hours before departure as the airline have many departures daily No queues at the checkin and the ground staff were good and answered questions though fearing speaking English Two BPs issued immediately Flying HKGPVG is considered as international flights though it could be considered as domestic That give the advantage of not leaving transit while leaving HKG and passing PVG First flight was on an aged A Extremely controlled and organised priority boarding at gate where all business and elite flyers were boarding entirely before the remaining passengers Onboard newspapers and channels of music were offered bring own headset Shared monitors showed some educational movies Food was limited to a tidy pack of biscuits Drinks were unlimited water tea coffee beers but only for hour out of the hour long flight during ascend and descend all services were closed down until Minutes after kickoff and again Minutes before landing That leaves passengers with very limited time of service FAs were fine The second flight were by Shanghai Airlines Boeing It was a very positive surprise and was faultless Modern aircraft good food and service hot meals offered at dinner and then again at breakfast Frequent drink rounds Button calls answered quickly and needs were addressed instantly Individual IFE on touchscreen monitors was very easy and quick to operate with a good number of Western and English translated movies Toilets clean Both flights took off earlier than scheduled

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

Arrived from Bangkok on Thai flight and still bussed to the terminal in June Queues for visa on arrival handled relatively quickly and luggage handling dealt with promptly and efficiently Friendly staff with a relaxed atmosphere

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended
A quick hop from Bangkok to Chiang Rai here No frills did the job perfectly left slightly early and arrived well on time Seats comfortable for an hours flight I still love the liveries of the airline

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

The staff are very friendly The queue times for checkin and security are almost always very short or non existent making for a very smooth fast and pleasant experience all the way to boarding For such a small airport there are also a good amount of amenities ample seating and it is always clean

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

At first I was not impressed by the airport as from outside it looks small and not modern But once in I was happily surprised with the efficiency of the airport both in the arrival and departure halls The wifi woked perfectly The facility is simple but clean and fast to navigate through The airport business class lounge was a great surprise Beautiful design very attentive staff great food and drinks selection Well done CKY
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Manchester Tripoli Late leaving Manchester due out at and eventually left at around pm Smallish plane two seats either side of the aisle but hardly anyone on board so plenty of room Plane was new and the experience was fine cabin crew were helpful and friendly and food was good No video screens or music so take your own or a book Will be using this route again

We had great experiences with Coastal on separate flights within Tanzania Our planes generally had passengers on board plus pilot and copilot For peace of mind we were permitted to check that our bags were in the cargo hold of the plane before boarding I was nervous about flying on such a small aircraft but all flights were smoother than expected and relatively short in duration We experienced excellent customer service via emails when arranging for our XL bags due to equipment for photography and diving and the staff member was able to answer our questions about transfer from the Dar Es Salaam domestic to international terminal Note Its a minute drive and there is a Coastal shuttle that runs between them Only a couple of minor flaws The air conditioning did not appear to be working on one of the planes while we were on the ground so it was very hot One of our flights inexplicably was delayed about minutes but fortunately it did not affect our itinerary in the least Overall I was very happy we chose Coastal Aviation for our interTanzanian flights and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed

I recently took two flights both of which provided a great experience First flight No CX from Chengdu to Hong Kong on an A Economy Class It was a very comfortable flight the cabin crew was outstanding and the food was good Second Flight NoCX from Dubai to Hong Kong on a Boeing BER Premium economy class This flight exceeded all expectations It was incredibly comfortable and the cabin crew was exceptional friendly helpful and truly dedicated The service on the ground and onboard was fantastic making the trip smooth The ample legroom allowed me to stretch out and relax while the wider seats extra recline and adjustable headrests provided the perfect setting for a good nights sleep The food was delicious offering a variety and flavour that made the experience wonderful I would like to thank Mr Philip from the Philippines whose outstanding service left a lasting impression This was a wonderful trip that I will never forget

Baghdad airport is OK It works without too much hassle It is a reasonably modern building There are linked terminals which you can easily walk between both airside and landside There is a restaurant landside and small cafes both sides Capacity is limited airside though Usual facilities landside mobile phone companies ATMs exchange etc If you have a long transit it is better to stay landside and visit the restaurant There are moderate queues for security and immigration can be a bit slow If you are not on Iraqi Airways there may not be any business lounge available certainly not for Turkish anyway

In May the new international airport terminal was opened in Fez It is an enormous improvement and upgrade on the previous terminal with a much more spacious and aesthetically pleasing environment In departures security can sometimes be a little slow but there is a clear and effective process which is greatly improved as compared to the old terminal Border checks on both arrivals and departures are much more efficient and swift There is a lounge available as well as pleasant shops and cafes in both arrivals hall and departures An entirely upgraded and pleasant experience travelling tofrom Fez
Good experience The flight assistants have been very kind and I arrived on time The cost of the ticket was really convenient I hope to fly again with them

Small and old airport One small ugly terminal with long queues Once past check in counter and paid php airport fee you are in a waiting area Waiting area is on two floors with several stalls selling food and drink but nothing spectacular One small duty free store as this place is an international airport but anybody can buy in this store Lavatorys even if not easy to be found are just ok Gives you the feeling you have been parachuted back to the this airport but all ended well

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

An excellent Domestic terminal very large and clean The security screening upon entering the airport for a am departure was fast and thorough Plenty of check in counters and efficient agents manning them The food is very expensive but I dont buy at the airport so no problem A very nice airport all in all

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

The usual service everything ok Lounge at Madrid airport is just great Late boarding and late departure due to traffic control arrived min late On board crew is just great as usual very attentive full lunch served with open bar Seat comfort nothing special but fine for a hr flight Everything worked out well they need to pay attention to punctuality

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Friendly little country airport in Australia Quiet clean terminal building with enough space for passengers using the frequent Regional Express Airlines Saab services This airport is well positioned between the towns of Narrandera and Leeton and has easy access to the main road to these centres It also has rental car services Best of all it was quiet and peaceful so one could do some work while waiting for flights no blaring television in the corner as is often the case these days Pleasant airport checkin staff at Regional Express as well
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future

I arrived at Cape Town International Airport and had to wait for my baggage almost minutes This was a local flight from JNB to CPT This is not my first bad experience of the same nature in recent weeks

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

Great regional airport Friendly people and some little shops It is nice and clean everything goes fast I have never waited more than minutes The flights to Munich and Frankfurt gives opportunities to travel from there and the flights to Antalya and other vacation destinations are great too

Small but efficient little island airport Quite possibly the cleanest terminal building Ive ever been in a small team of cleaners were walking around constantly dusting vacuuming polishing and looking for any litter the whole time we were there No fuss no overly loud announcements friendly staff obvious sign posting and a nice selection of shops which had very reasonable prices and unobtrusive sales assistants who didnt attempt to force anyone into buying things I really like this airport a lot the only thing Id mention is that try to remember its a tropical island so be careful where you leave your bags While waiting outside for the shuttle bus to take us to our rental car centre I saw a huge spider the size of the palm of my hand scurry into someones luggage Probably not the best start to that persons vacation but thankfully we managed to arrive and depart without any extra passengers with us

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

The schedules are well respected and the staff is excellent Boarding and disembarkation are quick The plane is clean and the information is clear Les horaires sont bien respects et le personnel est parfait Lembarquement se fait rapidement ainsi que le dbarquement Lavion est propre et les informations sont claires

When cabin crew ask for your feedback and thoughts on how they could improve you know they are genuinely committed to improving service To be honest I could not fault them on our hour mins flight The plane was fairly new very clean and the welcome aboard and service throughout exceptional I had to compliment the crew on the food The steak was perfect and tasted as if it had been cooked onboard It bettered my steak experience from steak cooked on board in first class I really look forward to flying Aircalin again and experiencing that level of customer service and care Highly recommended

Very nice new airport approx km from Warsaw The airport is easy to navigate the staff is very helpful There was no queue to check in or security control so it was good for family travel We ate a dinner in the airports restaurant the meal was tasty and there was a large selection of food for children There is also a small playground for kids nice thing if you have some time to spend The airport is very clean and quiet the terminal has a very good acoustic capabilities and there was no noise when we were waiting for the flight On the arrival journey everything was very quick just few minutes from the airplane doors to the luggage claim and city exit The car parking is just in front of the terminal building its much cheaper than at Warsaw Chopin airport theres also a bus station just next to the terminal

Was looking forward to flying with Solomon Airlines who were operating this flight on behalf of Air Vanuatu Check in was quick efficient and polite Boarding passes issued and invitation to the Air New Zealand Lounge where we sipped champagne and ate nibbles while we waited for our flight Boarding was quick and we sat in our allocated seats A C in Business Class Immediately offered champagneJuice or water before takeoff Naturally we had Champagne on this midday flight Cabin was clean airy and bright and the cabin crew were an absolute delight Friendly smiles everywhere and typical south pacific hospitality Lunch served was fresh very inviting and very tasty naturally followed by more champagne Flight time hours went by very quickly Even though the aircraft did not have WiFi no IFE and no charging ports that really didnt bother us as we were forewarned by researching in advance and we came prepared Its when youre not prepared travelling with kids and their electronic bits and pieces that they are forever glued to is where this could be an issue Be prepared Highly recommend Solomon Airlines and would be very happy to fly with them again

Ground staff at JFK could have been better I had a great deal of luggage and needed a special staff member to handle tagging It was hard to find him and found out he hadnt been informed for several minutes Seats comfortable to Casablanca good flight crew good catering Casablanca to Lagos had an excellent crew and the best airline catering Ive had in decades of traveling Id definitely fly them again

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it

Travellers arriving into SSA on international flights beware most of the cash machines in the airport for some unfathomable reason cease service at Particularly inconvenient since TAP and Air Europa flights from Lisbon and Madrid arrive shortly before midnight leaving international travellers with no Brazilian money This happened to me for the second time now which suggests it is a continuous issue There are three cash machines in the revamped Banco do Brasil right next to international arrivals which accept foreign maestro cirrus cards but they only issue a maximum of R per card which is just about enough for a taxi ride to the city centre and a beer Apart from this major issue which is strictly speaking not Infraeros fault but the banks SSA still remains an efficient and pleasant airport

This is a very nice airport Very clean and modern Airport staff are courteous and helpful It is definitely the best airport I have been to in the Caribbean and definitely better than some airports in the US especially Miami where you are not even offered free WiFi Nassau airport has complimentary WiFi everywhere Selection of popular restaurants inside the US departure lounge There are some shops but mostly expensive souvenirs A great experience hats off to everyone at NAS

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Pegasus and I must take a moment to commend Adnan the head cabin staff for his outstanding service Adnan is truly one of the best cabin staff I have encountered in a very long time From the moment we boarded his attentiveness and warm demeanor made a world of difference especially for my elderly parents and me Adnan was consistently polite and greeted us with a genuine smile which created a welcoming atmosphere on the flight His willingness to assist no matter how big or small the request was evident and greatly appreciated A particularly challenging situation arose during our flight when an incident of domestic violence occurred between a couple I was so impressed with how he handled the situation He remained calm and professional prioritizing the safety and comfort of all passengers His quick thinking and ability to diffuse the situation by separating the individuals without causing further disturbance to the rest of us showcased his exceptional skills in crisis management He is undoubtedly an asset to Pegasus Airlines His dedication to his role and the wellbeing of passengers is commendable

Much better now that they inaugurated the new pier More shops restaurants although some are overpriced and seats available Good staff and cleanlinessThe restrooms are very good and clean One problem is the distances between checkin and boarding

RGNMDL on ATR We were a bit sceptical when our travel agency booked on Air Yangon because we couldnt find much about this airline in Skytrax The plane left twenty minutes earlier than in our tickets stated so do reconfirm the day before No hassle with luggage and weight security checks as in the whole country very relaxed but efficient Comfortable seating on this short trip little snack for those who are extremely hungry Friendly staff clean plane and very pleasant flight We felt safe and would fly with them again

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air and I found this airline to be brilliant in all aspects Their prices are phenomenal and I couldnt complain about anything Check in was super fast and done with a smile The plane is a little outdated but its still new and growing The flight itself was mins and for such a short flight you even got a complimentary drink

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

MSL continues to be a good alternative to larger nearby airports Flew to see family in Late Nov and Early Dec of NWA continues to have flights a day to its Memphis Hub As with my previous experiences traveling through MSL the NWA and Airport Staff did a great job in taking care of their passengers Again a job well done by the MSL Airport and Airline Staff Also the New Marriot Hotel and Spa has opened the Robert Trent Jones Golf Course is also open for the avid golfer both of which are just minutes from the airport My round trip flights were flawless and running at or ahead of schedule outbound and inbound from the North West Alabama Airport

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance

A small airport serving only main highlight in the Red Centre of Australia the tourist attraction of Uluru and Kata Tjuta I arrived by domestic service I understood some international flights do use this airport so customs were negligible The airport is built on the edge of the desert and is surrounded by picturesque desert panorama Being tourist orientated all sorts of tourist services were available immediately upon retrieval of baggage A free tourist bus is available for pick up for everyone staying at the huge monopoly of Ayers Rock Resort about minutes away from the airport which unless you are a local thats where you will be

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Kuala Lumpur to Kuching return on Feb Overall vey satisfied with the experience An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew The airline offers an exceptional value for money The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wifi entertainment using own device The food is good for a domestic flight In both sectors boarding by groups and strictly follow The ground staff is good but can be better For one and half hour flight am not complaining

PER to MRU Efficient check in at Perth Airport Air Mauritius provides access to the Aspire Lounge at Perth which is actually a very good albeit open access lounge Aircraft was delayed due to delayed connecting passengers Boarding was around minutes late Aircraft quite modern clean and well presented Good amenity kits Welcome drinks served Business class seat is a standard lie flat but works well On the shorter routes like this they dont provide a mattress topper Lunch and drinks served after take off Food was good smoked salmon starter and lamb main Reasonably selection of IFE Staff responded quickly to any calls I managed a few hours sleep Afternoon tea served prior to arrival For an hours and minute flight the offering was a little limited and not presented with much flair Arrival was delayed and though off aircraft quickly immigration was slow Luggage waiting for us when we had cleared immigration My feeling is this represents a solid mid range business product

I feared for the crush that is too common at any Indian queuing point but neednt have For an early morning flight the only short delay was getting in to the terminal like all Indian airport terminals you have to show your flight documents After that checkin immigration security all wellmanaged and smooth at least no problems for me

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

The airport is really modern and beautiful Its very tidy and clean and has a lot of signs and announcements and a lot of staff that help out with your luggage the staff are really kind and the airport is really clean

Norman Rogers Airport CYGK in Kingston Ontario Canada is a small regional airport located about km east of Toronto and about the same distance west of Montreal Air Canada Jazz offers Dash and Beech service to Toronto times daily The return flight from Kingston to Toronto costs about if you have a connecting flight in Toronto Otherwise a flight from Kingston to Toronto costs a bit more Avoiding checkin in Toronto and the three hour drive to Toronto is worth the extra cost Kingston is a one building terminal and there is never anymore than pax to checkin for any flight Security is very thorough but is done efficiently and saves you the hassle of going through Toronto Pearson for security The terminal is one building and is currently undergoing renovations to improve service There are no restaurants in the terminal but there are a few vending machines AVIS does offer a car rental service but requires advance notice so a representative can meet the flight Overnight parking is only per hr period and is much cheaper than parking in Toronto The flight to Toronto takes min Baggage can be checked through to your destination from Kingston so there is no need to reclaim baggage in Toronto A nice little airport that makes a trip through Toronto Pearson a little more bearable

Entebbe airport sets good standards for an airport in Africa Though I do not recommend staying in it for hours it is still a clean safe place Coming from Sydney it is ok Its clean and the lounge is amazing Though having kids with me did make a hassle Otherwise its a nice quiet airport to go to Especially when the border security allowed me to go from the back to the front of the line I like it

The international terminal is small and because of that there are no endless walks which is great The visa on arrival staff were very quick and it only took a few minutes to be processed then it was the same going through immigration Our bags were waiting for us in the baggage hall after immigration then it was over to the taxi desk and straight into cab and on to our hotel On departing once again immigration was very quick then we had a short wait in the departure lounge which was very nice with a few shops and a good cafe

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

Norwich to Guernsey with Aurigny Air Online service very good when I was booking my seats months after booking the flights I noticed I had spelt my wifes name incorrectly but email to aurigny put that right with no extra charge The flight to Guernsey from Norwich was on time and landed early the same when coming back The flight had people coming back so about full complementary drinks are served which made a nice change The flight crew kept us informed through out the flight I would recommend this airline

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

After reading lots of reviews I was really sceptical about flying with WOW air I still went ahead and booked my ticket to detroit as it was the cheapest option for a one way and I had to book last minute which is always more expensive I decided to pay for selected seats up the front with extra leg room on both flights and got really lucky with having no one in my row for the first flight The second flight I chose a seat with no middle seat and was really happy with this decision As its a cheap airline a lot of people do not pay for the seat upgrade its really not expensive to purchase the extra leg room and well worth it for the comfort Plus you will likely not have many people around The food and drink on board is very expensive but as I knew this beforehand I purchased food and water at the airport to take on the flight with me I think I was lucky with the reliability of both my flights taking off on time as this was the one thing I was worried about The seats are very dirty front seat pocket but all airlines are usually quite unhygienic so this was to be expected The service on board I thought was great very friendly staff and attentive Overall I would say you get what you pay for and you are taking a risk booking with WOW air but lucky for me I had a good experience with them and would book again

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

KigaliJoburg June in an old narrowbody B I was upgraded from an inexpensive economy ticket to business class by using miles in their Dream Miles Frequent Flyer Program Checkin and lounge access in Kigali smooth as usual Luggage was kindly checked in to final destination legs ahead on different tickets and airlines Thats a courtesy winner which hardly any European airlines can cope with Checkin issued my onward Boarding Passes on the spot which made my life easy by staying in transits throughout the journey enjoying entitlements and lounges instead of struggling with immigration and landside eg in South Africa Lounge in Kigali is good though still with room for minor improvements Boarding easy by walking m on tarmac directly to the aircraft The business seats were in rows in x configuration I had D to avoid direct exposure to the rising morning sun In economy seats are narrower and in x configuration Morning flight departed on time and arrived slightly early Onboard seating perfect special meal accommodated other hot meals offered were also good No drinks and no food menu provided Unclear what they actually had onboard for catering Drinks and wine selection sparse and modest However we were offered predeparture champagne Piper Heidshick FAs were generous pampering us well and of world class in kindness and attentiveness They might benefit from further airline exposures IFE is useless no headsets given Given FFP miles instantly according to my original booking Luggage well handled Cannot demand much more for regional flights in business class

I found this airport to be surprising good for a European airport Getting through the airport was smooth and the terminal was busy but not crowded The Marco Polo Lounge was again very pleasant one of the best I have been to in Europe it even has an outside terrace with views of the apron which is a rare treat My only complaint would be the strange approach to the use of airbridges there were so many available and yet slow and cumbersome bus boarding seems to be standard operating procedure at VCE strange

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

Beautiful terminal and concourses in the new terminal Light and airy honestly the airport I would most enjoy waiting around in for a flight delay Also good food and shops and a general uplifting feeling Also the bus transit link back to Hong Kong was fast and efficient Going through security screening was a bit of a line but the check procedure was quick enough

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping

Just flew on a oneway flight from Zurich to Sarajevo and was extremely pleased The flight was carried out by their ATR aircraft which looked pretty new and was clean too We both departed and arrived early which I found great however What Id noticed is that the only type of entertainment they offered on board were the magazines in the seat pockets which were rather boring but this was after all a small aircraft so I wouldnt have expected anything else The plane was surprisingly full there were only about three unoccupied seats on board The inflight meal consisted of a very tasty sandwich and a wide selection of drinks Very kind cabin crew and they spoke really good English which was great I definitely recommend flying BH Airlines

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

Small but perfectly adequate airport On arrival we were through the airport within minutes of touch down though dont forget the US tax taken at passport control On departure we found the airport was shut and locked with lights off until am for departures that started at however it is modern enough with self service check in quick but thorough security with plenty of space in a light and an airy atmosphere There are now screens for departure information as well as the usual unintelligible tannoy calls and the only downsides were the exorbitant prices for snacks and drinks Duty free was a bit better but not particularly cheap either US for a coffee was times the price in the Best Western Hotel across the road
The conveyer belt was not working ground staff are limited and quite unsupportive no canteen to eat food But the airport is very clean Newspaper stand and water filter is well in sight

Lovely airport amazing views of the Alps Checkin was ok Wizz airline desks were poorly managed with long ques but the rest of the airlines seemed fine and so was security Shops were a bit lacking but overall a good airport

Most of the flights use the gates but even though they are empty many lowcost flights all except Air Astana Etihad etc use the ramps The staff were reasonably friendly and the immigration process was no bother compared to Tashkent Airport The airport itself is too small One of my friends in Business class decided to not use the lounge because it was just rubbish The staff dont really care if the people in the business class lounge talk loudly or anything The airports checkin could be improved and the domestic arrivals hall has too many taxi drivers trying to find customers Food choice is also limited but the duty free was actually pretty decent However I would not use this airport again but I have to next year

Ground staff friendly and professional Limited facilities at Albrook Airport but functional Couldnt do online check in but was smooth at the airport Older plane but was on time and smooth flight No real on board service so take your own snack or drink after airport security Flight was only mins so not a problem Plane does have a toilet Its not like flying a major international airline but its a short flight and was a good experience They even gave us umbrellas to walk to the plane as it had started to rain which was a nice touch Id seen other negative reviews so was pleasantly surprised how professional and polite their staff were Id use them again Its difficult to rate the actual on board service because there really isnt any no entertainment or food drinks but its such a short flight its not that relevant So I base my score on the overall experience Good service and on time flights with friendly staff but in flight service not really offered

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

The airline is convenient for the short trip between Bali and Lombok with few other carriers on this route There are regular flight schedules Due to passenger volume a twin propellor plane is used which are never as comfortable as a jet Overall I am happy the service exists however on this leg of the journey the plane had been sitting on the tarmac for a while and the air temp inside was extremely hot and even when in the air the air con was substandard and the cabin temperature was still warm to hot As is common with propellor aircraft there is no aerobridge which on this flight meant cross through rows of planes to get to the bus Both Air Wings flight departed and arrive on time which is good

Phoenix is the easiest of all major US airport to get in and out of I picked Phoenix as my home based in part because I needed a reliable airport considering how often I fly and PHX does not disappoint The new terminal is really excellent and the improved lounge situation at Terminal is really appreciated
