Another pretty solid trip with Jet A full package holiday was booked through them and they did not disappoint The flight times were good as they offered a decent early flight to get there and a leisurely enough time to return Checkinbag drop at Belfast was quick and easy with friendly staff and the boarding process was fast and well managed leaving the experience hassle free Onboard the plane was clear well kept and pleasant decent leg room for taller passengers as well The inflight shopping options seemed OK although this wasnt something that I would usually avail of however food and drink options were good enough Not bad in terms of range and price to match granted more than you would want to pay on the High Street but OK for a flight The staff really made the experience good with the crew friendly and very efficient getting food and drinks out quickly and picking up the rubbish after in good time Jet has been like this the last few times weve travelled with them so hoping this keeps up

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience

The arrivals area is pretty shabby but from disembarking the plane to getting on the bus to St Helier took less than minutes We departed from Jersey late afternoon on a Saturday when it was very quiet and so it was a very pleasant experience The staff at security and in the shops were all helpful and charming For the size of the airport the selection of shops and food were decent although there did seem to be a lack of seating after security however there was plenty at the gate
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

My bag disappeared into the abyss of their care and weeks later Im left with nothing but their hollow promises echoing in my ears Their customer service call begins with empathy sprinkled with reassuring phrases like Well escalate this immediately Spoiler alert immediately is Aer Lingus code for never Ive given up hoping theyll find my belongings Im now just curious if their lost luggage department is a black hole where all the unclaimed bags of the world congregate for a wild party Aer Lingus if youre reading this I dont need another scripted apology I need my bag or reimbursement

Upon arriving home after a lovely Thanksgiving trip I patiently awaited my luggage at the Southwest baggage claim My bag is very distinct and when it didnt come through I knew it was elsewhere I took my baggage claim sticker over to the office and the staff were absolutely wonderful He kindly assisted me and had a genuine demeanour that reassured me my bag would arrive later He told me where it was and when it would arrive Later in the afternoon he called me right at the time he said he would to alert me of my suitcases arrival When I went to pick it up he was so kind and polite to me I appreciated his enthusiasm and positivity He is truly a wonderful example of great customer service I wish all airport staff were as welcoming

A small domestic airport on Hamilton Island Queensland Australia very small but tidy and efficient Check in was a breeze and through security very quickly Lots of seating and only a couple of gates as planes restricted to daytime flights only Basic refreshments available and toilets although small were nice and clean You had a nice view of planes landing and parking close to the terminal and could see bags being loaded unloaded and the plane being refueled Very small but pleasant airport to wait for your flight

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor

Very pleasant and helpful staff With my arm in a sling it was hard to do most things but staff were ready to help and the canteen staff were friendly and professional Could do with more shops and a better variety

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

Flew from Lisbon to Las Palmas on th December Wasnt exactly sure what to expect from such a small airline The CRJ plane was fine albeit somewhat dated Service on board was very efficient with a nice spread of snacks for a hm flight I would definitely fly with them again A good airline
The duty free staff especially the fragrance section was very unprofessional Poor customer service No please to give feedback Otherwise the food and airport is good

We were very pleasantly surprised with our experience in Premium We normally fly Premium Economy on British Airways and this was a far better experience the plane was lovely and new and the crew were much friendlier The premium experience on board is good nice to have additional space and a private section of the cabin and the crew were generous with drinks The food was fine and we were pleased to be served two hot meals on the way out Our checked bags came off very promptly at both ends the Premium labels did seem to make a difference The only slight negative was that our flight left Gatwick late afternoon and the Premium check in line took longer than the normal one as they seemed to give priority to those checking in for next mornings flights Strange but didnt spoil the overall experience

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

DubaiKabulDubai in early December Kamair continues to be OK Both flights were close to being on time the only small delay down to Dubai air traffic They are now doing the luggage security check in Kabul which means you have to point out your case before it is loaded onto the aircraft Dont forget to do this if you want to see your case at your destination

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

IzmirAdnan Menderes is architecturally a very pleasing airport with lots of glass and steel giving it a very modern look The food and shopping were very good the restrooms were spotless and clean and it was very easy to navigate There is free wifi but only for two hours

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

I dont ever leave reviews but wanted to for the first of my flights with SAS I had a great time with this airline on flights over a long weekend trip The first flight from Heathrow to Copenhagen really stood out to me The two air stewardsesses were amazing and stood out as caring and genuinely interested A real asset to the airline The food on this first flight would not be my first choice but once i started eating it i was very happy Cant fault SAS on any of the flights They were on time and good flights Highly recommended

The great thing about this airport is its size It is small And that means a short walk from the aircraft through the building and out Baggage reclaim is basic you take it from the baggage truck outside but that is efficient and quick The arrivals area appears unfinished Check in and departure are also quick and easy If you want a drink in a nice bar use the place before the immigration After that there is only a small bar The duty free shop is cheap and quite well stocked There is wireless Internet at the airport but it does not work

Domestic flight AccraTamale hr flight One time in both directions Water juice and snack fish or meat pie savoury biscuits provided on this short flight more than you get on BA domesticEuropean flights three days Friendly and very polite cabin crew Marvellous captain who gave great information about the flight Joint venture between Hainan Airlines China Hahn Airways and Ghanian investors An excellent service which makes domestic travel much easier in Ghana

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

Pretty new terminal opened about a year and half ago Its an improvement on the old terminal Not many flights and of them from Ryanair Basic regional airport that does the job not huge lines to check in or pass security Dont go through security unless your flight its about to depart since in the air side there is only a little barcafeteria and two vending machines not too many seat if there are two flights at the same time In the land side good bar and resto Bad Bus connection to the city and expensive taxi service EUR to centre So overall small nice airport that allows you to show up h before your flight departs without risk of missing the plane

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

Have been travelling tofrom this smallish regional airport for around years Have seen a lot of improvements over this time The latest development has provided pax with good eatingdrinking facilities airside On arrival baggage claim is handy to car rentals whose parking lot is only a short walk Departure is easy with security queues usually short and its staff efficient and pleasant Gate lounges have plenty of seating and well placed monitors have the latest flight information Overall clean facilities and friendly mid west staff Always a pleasure to use this airport

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Hong Kong To be honest I did not expect much from a LCC The crew onboard were professional and nice and they tried their very best to communicate with passengers using English The plane was clean and tidy I do not mind having to pay for food and beverages and I do not care about the lack of entertainment Yet the seats are hard as rock which makes me feel like I am sitting on a wooden plank The seat pitch is completely ridiculous that I cannot even tie my shoelaces My height M Sleeping or even resting on the flight is simply Mission Impossible no matter how tired I was given the seat lacks basic support and the unbelievable seat pitch If your only parameter is cost and you can forgo all sorts of comfort go fly with them

FDHTHF Friendly staff clean aircraft with comfortable leather seats Orders for drinks and snacks taken and served individualy Prices on their inflight menu are OK Landing in Berlins Tempelhof airport is a fantastic experience Too bad the airport is due to be closed soon Even with bags to claim aircraft to subway station took less than Minutes Beat that

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

Flew on th of February Checkin staff in Miami was the best I ever experienced Fast friendly efficient pleasant Travelled with pet in cabin all formalities were dealt with rapidly and in a friendly way Boarding rapidly inflight crew very friendly We got the feeling that the flight attendants had pride in their job Food offering very good however service could have started slightly earlier Flight left delayed due to late arrival of incoming flight snow storm in Toronto But as we got an email from Porter advising of the delay we were able to leave to the airport later All in all a nice experience

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport
Fantastic Ample and clean restrooms Great restaurants Napping rooms available to rent Everyone was kind and assisted as needed They asked me if I needed help Super customer friendly service

Really nice clean small airport in terms of actual experience On arrival my Aer Lingus flight landed slightly ahead of schedule and I was airside within minutes from leaving aircraft door Immigration was a breeze and quick and the person checking passportsIDs was friendly and welcoming On departure security was fast and efficient and staff were relaxed and friendly The departure area is small but has couple of food options given the size and there was decent dutyfree area although I think greater part of this could be allocated to local products especially food given some of the really great quality stuff I had during my stay in Cork Toilets very clean and maintained and gate areas had plenty of seating The thing I loved though is they sell bottles of water for which you can just quickly tap and take from a stand no pricegouging and they have a refill station centrally located if you need refill it before you take off or if you brought your own bottle much better than Heathrow T when I left The only thing that lets this airport down and why I have marked it down is poor information on its website before travelling doesnt look like its been updated since covid and poor transfers from the airport to the city on arrival Taxis are expensive to the city at given the distance Bus to the city is regular service bus not a dedicated airport shuttle is only every half an hour in either direction and you need Leap card or euros no cards accepted This is inconvenient as international visitors wont necessarily immediately have the either of the former to hand I was lucky that a kind stranger on the bus paid for me using their own Leap card as the bus was waiting when I arrived if I had to go to get cash I would have missed it and had to wait half an hour for the next one Once on the bus it isnt clear when you arrive in the city as it is neither announced nor displayed on the electronic board just random street names and the bus runs with the lights off inside so you travel in the dark and it is all rather disorientating The stop in the city is also a random bus stop not the bus station which also makes it unclear where to get it from when you need to return to the airport from the city Im really perplexed why a city that has a lot of tourism has made it so difficultinconvenient for visitors in this respect and its a shame as the experience at the airport itself was excellent

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean

Gatwick to Larnaca Once you get on the plane all is well The customer service team on the ground not so great They claim they have no managers so the customer service advisors are their own managers Secondly to change your ticket they will only do this by arranging a call back and no other way If you ring to change your ticket they wont put you through to the team that deals with this but instead you need to wait for them to ring you back Very rigid and pretty appalling procedure if you ask me Customer service needs improving Lastly food on the plane could be better Compared to Aegean and British airways Cobalt business class food is economy plus

Spotlessly clean airport Fantastic cakes in departure Travelling to and from Kiev for Champions League final from Liverpool via Venice and Lviv Very smooth transit through Lviv Airport both ways Cakes were more memorable than the game unfortunately

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

BrisbaneHoniara Checkin a little slow but request for seat changes so our group could sit together handled without fuss A has comfortable seats with good leg room but no IFE despite old style screens throughout the cabin being available Catering is very basic and catering equipment is old and well used Toilets clean but are old and smelly Highlight was the crew who offered drinks throughout the flight not just responding to requests but proactively out in the cabin for the whole flight Recommend having breakfast before the flight and bring a book or iPad but otherwise an enjoyable flight and cheaper than Virgin

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

CAA replacement for Thomas Cook flight repatriation back to the UK after firms collapse Staff were excellent plane a little dated but clean and spacious also under subscribed Comfortable great service thank you all
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

I have flown Porter on other occasions and have many good experiences I was supposed to travel with them in April but due to an accident I would not be able to with upcoming doctor and Physio appointments The customer service representative Erin was phenomenal She listened and asked questions as to address my issue with regards to my upcoming flight I am now able to have time to heal myself and take my flight at a later date Thank you Erin and Porter

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

This is an excellent new airline everything was perfect from the checkin to boarding onboard experience meals video entertainment the flight and baggage retrieval All the staff were friendly and very helpful Will definitely choose this airline again At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

Flew Amsterdam Schiphol to Marseille via Strasbourg Hop has good service and comfort levels for a regional airliner Their inflight announcements in English need some work though On my flights I was on an Embrear which has an odd seating arrangement of The seats were comfortable and not cramped The flights were staffed by a single cabin manager but they handled the job of getting everyone onboard and serving a complementary drink with a snack on each leg well Their inflight announcements in English were completely incomprehensible however as were the recorded announcements in English as well Since I dont speak French I just hope they werent telling me anything important On one leg of my flight there was a brief delay but this was communicated in a timely manner

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

As I was travelling in Emirates Business class from Tehran I was able to use the VIP terminal just around the corner of the main terminal It was very clean stylish and modern for Iranian standards Emirates passengers got to use the whole second floor which provided a good buffet nice leather seats clean prayer room and very clean toilets The customer service and security checks were also quite decent despite being busy during the day

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Security was super helpful As we were passing through security someone stole my wifes Apple Watch from the box after we went through the Xray We immediately notice it was missing and reported it Security checked the cameras and found the thief Using the image from the cameras they tracked down the passenger and recuperated our watch All this within minutes Amazing

Horizon Air from Seattle to Eugene roundtrip No complaints the crews were great planes clean and on time in both directions As with all of Horizon Air flights free beverages including wine and beer are provided The aircraft was perfect for the less than one hour flight to SeaTac quite fast actually The skies were clear and the view was perfect Nice job all the way around

Seoul Incheon to Tokyo Narita with Easter Jet This was a low cost airline but everything was fine Check in took five minutes I paid extra for a bulkhead seat and it was worth it The seats were quite narrow but bearable for a two hour flight There was just a small drinks run and no food available but as it was only a two hour flight it was acceptable

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

Me and a few friends flew to the Dominican Republic in August and the experience upon arrival was outstanding The immigration service was fast and most shops where open The staff help us with our bags and had us out in no time On our way back it was the same very friendly staff no delays food was great on the terminal shops

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean

Flew flybe BE Belfast to Amsterdam on October th Checkin opened hours prior to departure and the check in process was very efficient Boarding was called minutes prior to departure and the boarding process was also fast and efficient The onboard cabin crew were outstanding and very helpful throughout the flight and we landed minutes ahead of the scheduled time There is not a full catering service onboard however teacoffee and snacks are provided free of charge Overall I was very happy with flybe service on this Belfast to Amsterdam fight

Thoroughly workmanlike return flights Johannesburg to Cape Town Cabin crew were efficient and personable Seats AC had adequate leg room Food was adequate and it was helpful to see the three main courses before choosing one Both flights arrived ahead of schedule

We had a really good experience at Luton Started well with the official meet greet parking in Car Park this is clearly signposted and we were met by a very pleasant and helpful gent quite a contrast with our rather dismal Heathrow experience in May It was a short walk to bag drop in the terminal which was also done quickly and on to security This was a real standout with short queues and friendly staff No need to remove liquids computers and so on and they do a fullbody scan for everyone that saves the palaver of being beeped by a standard gate and going for the full scan My bag was selected for extra checking that was swift and polite It took about minutes from car park to airside where we found plenty of decent options for breakfast All in all a very positive start to our holiday

For a small town scale Manado airport is pretty good Has several places for check in Several lounges equipped with internet access and good food The lounge area is quite spacious and has good service from Avsec This airport is set as the transit airport for Raja Ampat another greatest diving spot in indonesia located in Papua and also has an international direct flight like Singapore etc

Sarajevo Airport is very small and very manageable After you enter the main building there are check ins Afterwards you have to go to the first floor where is one departure hall with or departure gates There is plenty of seating they also have big beanbags for seating which can be quite fun and relaxing There is only one bar with snacks and one shop If you are travelling with children the signs for baby changing room is misleading after you follow the signs there is no baby room You have to follow the signs for the bathroom for disabled If you wait for a long time you might get very bored

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

My first time flying MEA and I found it to be an excellent airline The planes were new clean and comfortable The business class seats are not lieflat which is fine given they only do shorthaul routes but they have a good recline function TV monitors and tables are in the armrests regardless of your seat Service was warm friendly and professional the staff were engaging cheerful and consistently present in the cabin Predeparture drinks were served though alcohol was only offered on the ground in Beirut Once in the air another round of drinks was offered and then drinks were served with the meals I opted for the Champagne which was decent I thought the food was very good for a hour flight you had a choice of starters mains and dessert each served individually IFE was good an uptodate selection of movies and series My departure from LHR was delayed by over hours but they kept us updated With the exception of this I thought it was a great airline and given its shorthaul network the service and quality of food was excellent
Small but very pleasant Nice staff and decent facilities Better than any of the larger airports

You often have to wait on a remote parking slot for buses to arrive flights have narrow time windows to land or take off which leads to delays both at the origin and destination Can definitely be better managed Geneva airport model would suit it perfectly It is extremely central and convenient You almost arrive on the historic zone of Lisbon

Ground staff friendly and professional Limited facilities at Albrook Airport but functional Couldnt do online check in but was smooth at the airport Older plane but was on time and smooth flight No real on board service so take your own snack or drink after airport security Flight was only mins so not a problem Plane does have a toilet Its not like flying a major international airline but its a short flight and was a good experience They even gave us umbrellas to walk to the plane as it had started to rain which was a nice touch Id seen other negative reviews so was pleasantly surprised how professional and polite their staff were Id use them again Its difficult to rate the actual on board service because there really isnt any no entertainment or food drinks but its such a short flight its not that relevant So I base my score on the overall experience Good service and on time flights with friendly staff but in flight service not really offered

LAN is a true premium airline Flew in their Premium Business from MilanMalpensa to So Paulo Guarulhos late night and the service was fantastic Had only hand luggage because it was a short trip As soon as I got onboard I was welcomed and escorted to my seat by the purser Immediately I was offered a glass of champagne Other offers were Pisco Sour and water Dinner orders were taken quickly and served promptly after the take off Their business class cabin has the configurartion of which is good if you have company If not you might find yourself sitting to a stranger for hours I had this several times and the comfort was still good My breakfast order was taken seriously I got everything I wanted I need to emphasize this because there are other premium airlines who fail to arrange the breakfast according to customers wishes The crew just seem to enjoy their jobs and you can see that the service is personal you get addressed by your name and you pay business class but you get almost first class treatment LAN is always a great choice and will always stick to them

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

With flights starting at around USD between Seoul and Yantai Shandong Airlines proved to be the cheapest option beating Asiana China Eastern and Korean Air Given the price I was a little hesitant to believe the service to be of a high level however I was pleasantly surprised I was given a friendly greeting in English on boarding crew holding a basket of sweets for passengers to take as they headed to their seat For the rest of the flight the crew seemed to conduct their service pleasantly with a smile On the outbound flight to China apple chips and bottles of water were offered however on the return leg a delicious hot meal was offered consisting of a sweet and sour type meat dish with rice Highly surprising considering the flight time was less than an hour Interestingly on both flights the captain performed a detailed speech in Chinese and English Despite the fact that the Boeing was several years old it was fitted with Boeings Sky interior and its interior seemed to lack any signs of wear and tear The interior including the toilets appeared to have been cleaned well The seats were comfortable and had ample legroom for the short flight The IFE onboard consisted of overhead screens these played the moving map on the outbound flight at Mr Bean on the return journey Overall a good journey

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

Nice and small airport at El Alto La Paz The process to get my bags was average in time and customs was friendly and polite There are a few cafes and a couple of restaurants I could see Ground transpiration is readily available by taxi or minibus The airport is not a big building but it has wifi it is clean and has many standard services

Clean and efficient nice ground staff homemade pies in the cafe upstairs You feel you are welcome Then sq foot or less per person when Ryanair process their passengers from flights at the same time through the only gate Just dont get into that huge black hole after the checkin thats not the entrance but the place to drop your luggage in A bit confusing But the good thing is that upon arrival you walk no more than yards from the plane through the custom and luggage reclaim to the coachtaxi Beware there is no ATM around Nice service but very basic facilities

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK

Wonderful airline Both going to and coming back from Whitehorse I really enjoyed flying with them Flights were on time No trouble with checked baggage Staff were super friendly They even provided a complimentary sandwich and warm cookie on a flight that was just over two hours I have a high opinion of this airline and would gladly fly with them again Thank you Air North

Nice clean provincial airport handy for Asturias Cantabria and Galicia The checkin hall is spacious and on the occasions Ive used it it has always been hasslefree The cafe is large and reasonably priced and the toilets clean There are a half dozen care hire booths in the airport I always use the bus to get into and out of Oviedo It is cheap euros single and runs regularly from the stop outside the arrivals hall Regular buses also run to Gijon and Aviles There are plentiful taxis if you want a more expensive drive in The only mild criticism I have of the airport is the time it takes to get through customs on arrival Other than that a pleasant airport which nearly makes flying pleasurable

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

Awful from front desk to boarding airport is like a sauna staff are rude and dont want to be here but then there is only a handful of staff No information for English lucky I speak Italian it makes you appreciate Gatwick and Heathrow

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

Santiago de Chile to Isla de Pascua Had the opportunity to fly with LAN from Santiago de Chile to Easter Islands a trip I had been expecting tor a long time Although the LAN web site indicated that you should report to checkin a whole hours before scheduled departure time I decided to play it cool and only arrive at the Santiago airport at for a am flight just to see that checkin was still well in progress without any rush Upon boarding the Boeing I just loved the cabin interior very light and roomy with nice LED lights around When finding my seat I soon realised however how small it was Im sure is the narrowest airplane seat Ive ever seen and the legroom was very short for someone of cm I was happy that I was only going to spend hours and not on this plane However I soon found the IFE which offered a great selection of top recent films certainly far too many for this six hours flight As I hadnt downloaded the LAN application on my tablet beforehand there would have been even a greater choice of entertainment available for this flight Soon after takeoff an excellent breakfast with fresh fruit and an omelette was served During the rest of the flight drinks and coffee were served several times The best part of this flight was however the Chilean LAN cabin crew The steward serving my section was chatting around making jokes and asking several times if I needed something more This is the kind of service I would have expected in First Class but here I was enjoying it in Economy Well done LAN

Toykos nd airport smaller and closer to the city Arrival process OK but suffered from being rather manual with queues for immigration and then passport control despite offering online advanced registration Baggage reclaim quite quick Excellent transport links by bus train or taxi clear signs in Japanese and English Ticket Machines for trains ONLY take cash but do give change and are fantastic value for money Leaving Japan the process is very speedy with Bag Drop etc and then Security and automated passport gates There is a cafe on the Arrivals Level if you arrive too early to checkin or are waiting to be picked up on arrival Within the terminal is the usual array of shops and eating places focused more on the regionallocal travellers rather than the full Duty Free range of goods you might find elsewhere in the region Reasonable seating near the departure gates and overall quite quick turnround of planes

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Terminal was fairly good Despite the bustling atmosphere the staff were efficient and helpful The terminal isnt very well organized but the clear signage made it easy to navigate The dutyfree area provided a good amount of choices the terminals facilities are old but clean and despite the usual rush of the terminal at the time I found a peaceful corner to relax before my flight Overall its not the best airport I have been to but it has a good potential for upgrades and enhancement and I can see them trying to achieve it

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

Swanky new recliner seats around Gate but only if you are under foot or over foot tall At the headrest was painfully positioned forcing my chin onto my chest Shame because everything else is brilliant

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

The checkin staff was very helpful and I had a smooth checkin process I received an aisle seat in the exit row with loads of legroom However that is where the good part ends the aircraft was not very clean and the inflight service consists of a juice nuts and the thinnest bar of Cadbury Diary Milk chocolate you will ever see They did not seem to have any menu for purchase as well After spending hours in the Domestic Terminal at Male where nothing is available to purchase and then going through a hour flight with nothing to eat is not the best experience There is a single attendant on the flight who passes by once to hand out the food and once to take the trash The experience is certainly not comparable to domestic flights in Asia and a tad disappointing especially given the premium prices in Maldives The good thing is that the flight was absolutely on time

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Surabaya is my hometown airport I was really happy when Terminal opened but I think they could improve the facilities such as food and stores Surabaya is a simple airport the terminal is quite clean toilets huge spacious check in and waiting room I spend a lot of time here but I have never used the WiFi so I dont know about the speed Airport staff are attentive

I was on an Aer Lingus flight operated by Cityjet My flight was late due to weather in London and my original flight got cancelled but I got put onto a flight minutes later The flight itself was OK The seats on this little Avro are very cramped Cityjet uses a configuration instead of the standard This makes the seats very thin and leaves you with not much room The inflight catering was provided by Aer Lingus and featured a buy on board service As this was a morning flight I opted for a Hot chocolate and some shortbread and for this was decently priced But the highlight of this flight was well and truly the Avro RJ which I wanted to fly on before they all get retired and I am very pleased I did It is a unique experience and I would recommend for any aviation fans to try this flight as it is relatively cheap and the Avro is an absolute joy

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

Gatwick is above all an experience An experience for the eyes nostrils and hygiene that might not exactly be considered favorable Bear in mind I come from the US We have some excellent major airports but also some rubbish ones Gatwick would easily be considered to be among the worst of what Im used to in the US and its the worst major airport Ive seen yet in Europe other than possibly Otopeni in Bucharest The only nice part of Gatwick I saw was the train station upon exiting the national rail Otherwise the checkin areas are depressing and run down like a throwback to whenever Thatcher was prime minister yet without any good cleaning since that time The checkin as well as gate personnel with Norse Atlantic Airlines were honestly surly professional but surly The security process is a hot mess and lines are incredibly long at least I had paid the pounds or so for expedited security While I made it through security quickly I still had to swiftly pay attention to what was going on Walking through the south terminal there were very few places to sit and eat At least the employees at the Pret were nice The floors were dirty and sticky The toilets and accompanying sinks looked like they were also from the Thatcher era The terminal had a pervasive damp dank flatulentlike odor to it not sulfur but still odd and gross Final point I usually like British people for their politeness but Gatwick is a place to see some of the worst in British people In closing if you have to come to London fly to Heathrow as at least some parts of it feel like a proper airport or to London City which is very small and easy Very clearly the privatization of many British airports has not served the British traveler well at all
