TSA are extremely rude To the gentleman in the tsa pre line learn manners if youre going to be working with customers or work in the back in a dark room away from people If Im asking you something dont have attitude when responding Im asking to know because I dont know the answer sarcasm is not needed Also out of the airports Ive been to throughout the world this is the first to tell me my cosmetic items were too large I think it goes without saying priorities need to be shifted and staff reexamined

Not much has changed in this airport built a years ago The outside is decrepit Security is virtually non existent Touts were able to penetrate the immigration arrival area where apparently for a fee they assist arriving passengers with the immigration forms I witnessed this with a group of Chinese arrivals More touts swarm you in the baggage arrival area where you are also hustled to part with cash in order that they may assist you through customs Everybodys luggage is supposed to be searched before exit but I think this is more of a money grab The whole experience can be very unsettling to the western traveller Exit was not much better The airport staff often try to extort money for hand luggage with limits set at kg A small bribe will get you past this nuisance I forgot to pay airport tax before getting to the immigration counter so the immigration officer graciously offered to collect it for me From my hands it went straight to her left pocket Duty free is rather limited A few arts and crafts stands some selling local music cds dvds local tea coffee and some snacks An airport to avoid even by African standards Security screening is performed by the airlines themselves The only place where I was not hassled by money was in the toilet No way I can foresee the FAA approving direct flights to the US from this airport

Although a new airport Hatay Antakya is a seriously disappointing and inadequate experience The terminal building is the size of an average suburban house meaning it is woefully illequipped to handle the two daily flights it receives The sole baggage belt in the Arrivals room is about m long and when people deplane the queue to get at the belt is about people deep The one person they appear to have employed to handle baggage means at least mins wait for bags from a plane a mere meters away Stepping out of this tiny reclaim area and finding yourself literally in the car park is a good indication of how minimal this airport is Cannot comment on the departures side but presume this is equally as small The link road to the main highway is still unpaved Bizarre

I had a return flight booked with WestJet from Lethbridge Alberta to Victoria BC back in late August There was a connecting flight through Calgary Alberta I was scheduled to leave Lethbridge at am August but received a message from WestJet at pm the day before that my flight from Lethbridge had been cancelled I spent about hours before finally contacting an agent who rescheduled my am connecting flight from Calgary the next morning to a later flight as I was not able to rearrange my schedule including alternate packing and a hour drive to Calgary the next morning I then had to park my car at ParkGo for the entire week I was to be gone and pay them I lodged a complaint to WestJet upon returning and finally received a reply after four and a half months of waiting My request for reimbursement was denied due to unplanned aircraft maintenance which they do not compensate you for I did receive compensation for my cancelled flight from Lethbridge to Calgary but not the cancelled return flight Some consolation On top of that I have found that the WestJet staff are not nearly as friendly or accomodating as they used to be In the future I will make every effort to fly with another airline as i feel WestJet even though I am a Rewards member does not offer reliable service nor accommodation for their lessthanacceptable behaviour

This airport is always a breeze Small and compact but with ok facilities considering the size Staff is almost always friendly and downtoearth Few if any lines Clean and good WiFi They might need security in the baggage reclaim as two toddlers got on the belt just as it started moving Seemed very dangerous and the parents were present but completely oblivious Never seen such bad parenting at an airport before The family was Danish Parking is no longer free but DKK per day A very silly move

This is an interesting airport for Domestic flights throughout Brazil Check in area is full of lines for all different airlines and like old style the airline offices are opposite to check in Many people buy tickets same day at the airport Not many people speak English but if you ask someone if they do they will try or get someone who does if they do not I checked in for my flight on GOL and had hours They would have put me on the earlier flight if there was seats available even with the departure leaving in minutes Prior to security the main building has a round waiting area with shops food areas and so forth If you go to the second floor you will find an Internet cafe barber pharmacy police etc Go to the third floor for a wonderful outdoor bar and a full service restaurant full of TVs and a wonderful buffet You can stay as long as you like and be away from the throngs of folks travelling especially on weekends Past security is the new terminal that is huge and if your gate is at the end it will literally take you between to mins to get there No moving walkways There are snack bars and little shops along with plenty of seating NOW You need to understand that there are several gate changes and the ONLY main screen is after security So be sure of your gate if you can Anouncements were made in Portuguese and then English every time People will help you if you dont speak Portuguese just ask Signage is also in English but if you are going out to get a taxi or bus you must take the elevator if you want to keep using your free trolley Taxi line can be long and if you are going outside the city to say the International airport they will charge you additional to the fare Thats the law Take one of the buses if you can to transfer to Guarulhos

Arrival was super speedy world class speed by the immigration guy Airport facilities money changer is up until the time we arrive in there early pm ish local time Kudos to the landside staff However departure is a different story travelers are mire with last minute opening of AAX counters where usually it opens three hours ahead of time however at IKA it opens hours before departure time For non Iranians immigration queue is super long with one female officer working only we had to queue for more than minutes just to clear our passport Before immigration the seats are not enough to contains all the travellers and after the immigration there isnt any trolleys to move the luggage of us Good part about IKA you will feel safe in the airport with thorough checks and the presence of officers in military fatigue the security here is top notch After immigration there are sleeping benches at the most behind of gates Improvements to be done add more chairs before the immigration speed up the passport clearance and introduce trolleys after immigration

Sat th Dec we sat in departure lounge for hrs with no information from pm Eventually we board pm and told we are being diverted to Madrid to change crews A hour later we are told we are being booked into a hotel in Madrid for the night and flying home in the morning Then the story changed to the hotel has been cancelled and were booking you into a hotel in Gran Canaria go collect your luggage and meet us At a EasyJet rep told us we cant get you a hotel goodnight and check your app for your rearranged flight home We watched the staff leave for there booked accommodation Unable to find a bed we ended up on a beach for the night Our rearranged flight was originally for but left at After numerous apologies from the captain we was offered a free teacoffee or water as a good will gesture but they had no food left as the plane wasnt restocked Landed hrs later The biggest disgrace is they have denied compensation and blamed air traffic control extraordinary circumstances pp Yet two of us have had different excuses I have ATC report confirming they are not being honest I have ATC report showing every flight landing that evening into Gatwick except only one cancelled was ours including Easyjet flights yet they said it was passenger safety Easyjet are a disgrace

Zurich to Ljubljana Very poor customer service Flight was cancelled without sending any email confirmation The flight I was rebooked seemed to be overbooked at the beginning which was not trueand we had to wait min to have our ticket changed Very bad experience overall

The worst airport that I have visited The checking process is slow security check did not even have trays and was so slow that I almost missed my flight The food was full of garbage on tables that no one was clearing The whole experience was awful

Paris to San Francisco Extremely sketchy airline They cancelled our flight back from Paris due to operational difficulties and said they could only book us on a flight days later They would not refund us the money for the flight even though they could not offer anything even close to what we booked Their customer service just sent us in circles call this number call back tomorrow submit a ticket here email this address call this other number The company hides behind their phone reps having them continuously say The company has issued a statement saying they will not refund anyones money for the flight If you cancel a flight and can only replace it with a flight two days later you better give customers the opportunity to take a refund
The airport is tiny Too many passengers use this airport The potential of this City is enormous Government needs to show some care for Coimbatore

Absolutely appalling airport Barely any seating places to eat or toilets When the airport gets busy the whole place comes to a standstill If possible always fly tofrom Rome Fiumicino as it is much much better

Mandalay International Airport was built at the turn of the st century It serves both domestic and international destinations and is designed like many airports around the world it just works slightly differently somehow Arriving on a domestic flight you are bussed into the single terminal building where you walk passed unmanned Passport Control Desks to one of baggage carousels before having your baggage hand and hold scanned and into a large Arrivals Hall with the usual selection of booths and a small cafshop selling bottled water There are TV Screens showing which flights are coming or going Marble floors and air conditioned Departures start with the need to scan all you bags hand and hold before going to Checkin Counters which are clearly numbered in banks A B C and D After this is the a boarding pass check and into the Departure Hall which is upstairs Checkin and arrivals are on the ground floor There is a large selection of shops and a couple of barcafes not all of which are open for domestic flights Security Scanning is done at the gate and Gate seems to be where all the domestic flights leave from via a pier down to a bus In the Gate area there are no shops or toilet facilities just rows of seats looking out on to the apron and in the distance the runway parallel to the terminal building The airport is larger than the current traffic levels so it does not feel crowded or too busy but it has a new feeling that none of the other airports in Burma Myanmar have

I recently flew business class on Turkish Airlines from JFK New York to Istanbul and unfortunately my experience was far from what I expected The aircraft felt outdated with uncomfortable seats The cabin temperature was unbearably high turning the entire hour flight into a sauna While the food was passable I found it below the standard of other airlines business class offerings My connecting New York to Rochester flight was canceled with no assistance from Turkish Airlines No automatic rebooking No refund or apology I had to book a sameday ticket on a different airline at my own expense just to get home Reaching customer service was a nightmare they were dismissive unhelpful and indifferent Each call ended with them simply asking me to leave feedback on their website Emails were ignored and when I finally spoke to a ground agent they were rude and uncooperative Despite multiple attempts I received no refund no compensation and no resolution This level of service is unacceptable especially for a businessclass passenger I will never fly Turkish Airlines again
Parking is extremely expensive at Torp Sandefjord Airport NOK Approx an hour better to go to OSL No customs staff available for customs refund of VAT

Manila is a very crowded and busy airport I have been through here a number of times Its sad that in this day and age you have to lug your bags to a bus to get a connecting flight to Terminal Still I guess it is what it is Bus was crowded and very hot I guess this was to be expected as this was a very busy time when I was traveling Signage has improved a lot since my last visit I was able to find my way to my gate very quickly Always crowded here I feel that they could perhaps improve the air conditioning a little Aside from that little to complain about

The airline is unnecessarily expensive and provides almost nothing as a service The meal should be bought The price is high and quality is poor Airline does not even offer water Additionally if you need a blanket you should pay a cost of OMR Most of the seats is selected via a payment method No entertainment is available No cabin wifi This is disgustingly annoying policy

Small regional airport mostly domestic flights with limited international flights Was told it was built to accommodate World Cup in South Africa You can definitely tell the airport interior and parking facility are modern and efficiently laid out Because it is a small regional airports you shouldnt expect too much on shopping or dining options However for an airport this size its shops and restaurantcafe options seem adequate actually surprisingly many One short coming is its dining food court area It was rather poorly laid out and seem unwelcoming

I have flown with Thomson now Tui before to the Canaries and it has always been okay The staff are friendly and there was very expensive food and drinks on offer should you want to buy anything My biggest issue on my latest flight was the size of the seat There was literally no leg room I am only and my knees were touching the seat in front and they were so narrow they were almost impossible to sit in When I was told to put my bag under the seat in front it left nowhere for my legs It was the most uncomfortable four hours of my life never again

Was booked in as requiring Disabled Assistance with processing through departures Due to the Covid problems paperwork required to depart the airport after our holiday The company I booked and payed for the Covid day test failed to give me a code for the Passenger Location form I spent days of our holiday just trying to get this code Without this form we could not fly home Finally just before pickup time I finally got this code and partially film of two of the forms I thought thats great can finish the two at the airport How wrong I was got to the stage they were calling us on the speakers I cannot thank the two young Special assistance girls at the desk We managed to board the plane mins before take off time Had they not been so understanding and helpful we would not have flown home Zante Airport you have brilliant workers on the Disabled Special Assistance

How can you accept planes and not have a gate to deplane Sat for minutes on the tarmac upon arrival and then was delayed hours on departure Once we boarded we had to wait another minutes for someone to put gas in our plane Baggage claim was a hot mess Multiple passengers getting only some of their bags We needed to wait for two other planes to unload their luggage before getting our second bag Hundreds of people waiting for flights that disappeared from flight boards Lines of customers waiting to speak to service agents that came and left the area without explanation or serviced people outside of the established lines There was another desk with three uniformed staff members carrying on conversations amongst themselves and a sign stating the desk was closed Sassy condescending updates far and few between TSA line longer that regular check in

This airport cant seem to handle the passenger traffic I was flying American on May my flight was delayed to the point that I wouldnt make my transfer I was bumped to the next day and the checkin lines were so incredibly long that I missed my flight the next morning and was forced to fly standby I have heard similar things from friends flying Southwest Airlines at this airport

Luton Airport always used to be a joke and it still is as far as queue management is concerned As you approach Security old young and infirm are forced to walk up and down unnecessarily for miles between taped barriers even when there is hardly anyone waiting to go through Security Staff with ironically Im here to help yellow teeshirts stand aimlessly around and rather than helpfully opening and closing the queuing lanes as demand dictates their job seems limited to shouting at anyone who has the temerity to duck under a barrier even when there is noone in front of them When challenged one of the staff unhelpfully stated if you dont like it you can buy Fast Track ie pay more to avoid walking needlessly backwards and forwards clearly this is the managements intention to make life difficult for most passengers Awful customer service come on Luton Airport time to up your game

We arrived days ago at night and the rental car situation was an absolute mess When we showed up at the airport today during the daylight it wasnt much easier to figure out the mess outside The Allegiant check in staff seemed overworked and grumpy The airport needs some serious traffic flow help inside and outside

Absolute nightmare I couldnt sign in and have credit on their account so they changed the email of my travel credit to another email quickly and willingly then I couldnt use it for seats and bags on a flight with another email despite me sending my ID I spent hours on their useless chat bot services as there is no helpful phone line Then hours queueing at the airport They have kept the credited money and made me pay again Ill never use this airline again in my life the worst experience Ive ever had they are a shambles

Srinagar Airport is quite an experience but then so is the whole of Kashmir for Europeans travelling there The airport is currently in the process of being rebuilt so arrivals are processed in what can only be described as a shed Departures use the halffinished terminal where it is impossible to hear announcements due to the deafening construction noise There is dust and noise everywhere although it looks as if it might be quite nice when its finished Be prepared to be repeatedly screened monitored searched and grilled every couple of steps along the way by a mixture of airport staff troops and military police and dont expect them to be polite or friendly they are not

I had a flight scheduled to leave a in the morning connecting in La Guardia Several delays and flight changes later I finally managed to get on a plane and then had to wait in the plane for another hour because La Guardia had shut down airspace I will have to figure out another connecting flight because of this and they made me check my carry on so God knows where that will end up This has been a complete nightmare I will never fly through La Guardia again

Horrible level of customer facing employees in Riyadh station today I was flying to Dubai I came minutes prior to the flight time I approached the supervisor he directed me to stay in the queue the line took me minutes to reach the counter then I was surprised that the flight got closed when I re approached the supervisor his tune of voice and attitude was so rude with shameful level of professionalism I approached the station Manager their he refused to state his name or title and did not even listen to my complaints I am so shocked by the quality of Flynass front line employees beside losing my flight to Dubai which is my smaller issue I felt badly directed and unheard when I had an issue

Security rude and disrespectful I am a senior and passed through security as usual Generally I am very pleased that the security check is made as it gives a feeling of safety while flying Much to my regret and have to say some negative comments regarding the check I had to run through The start was very normal but continuation was pretty rude as the woman in charge spoke German without asking me if I could understand it or not She showed me that I had to place my shoes on a little a little step than she asked something in German I got as she was asking me to take off my shoes for inspection which I did Than she started screaming at me and wanted me to put on my shoes again and show only the bottom soles of the shoes without any possibility to hold myself for securing this position I am a frequent flyer and this was the first time I had this type of rude behavior toward a senior

Dinard Airport arrival experience was excellent I was second off the plane so got out within minutes Departure was a nightmare hrs queuing to get through passport control and security Theres only one Douane and security lane which isnt enough for full Ryanair flights Our flight had to be delayed by mins so everyone could get on Once in the departure lounge there is limited seating and a vending machine thats all and just toilets for everyone The terrace bar before security is very nice though

We recently flew from Santorini to Rome on Blue Panorama airlines Upon arriving at checkin we were forced to pay an additional E to Blue Panorama due to the fact that my wifes middle name was not shown on the actual booking For clarity her name appeared as it does on her passport the booking was in their system but it merely did not have her middle name shown on the booking I explained that her legal identity was the same as the booking and showed multiple forms of identification to no avail I am not sure how this could be the case but we were nevertheless forced to pay this extra amount of E We witnessed other passengers being stung in a similar fashion and one family of four was forced to pay E When I objected I was told no pay no fly This is outrageous and amounts to no more than theft and is in my opinion a complete scam being operated by this airline

Both flights I took from Thessaloniki to Athens return had a delay The aircraft was tiny and the air condition was blowing warm air It really felt like a bus The cabin crew was professional kind and tried to counterbalance this mess The ticket was a bit cheaper relative to other companies but very expensive considering the level and the quality of service provided

Milan to Tirana Scammed and held at ransom for new tickets I cannot believe we have been cheated out of new tickets at the checking in desk No middle name no boarding We fly very often and cant remember last time middle name was required I fully believe this is unfair to make more revenue from already paying customers The airline was fined in by the Italian Competition Authority for this ery issue It is impossible to get through to the complaint department if there is one You have to write a letter and send to Italy Cannot call or email Avoid if you can or at least dont forget middle name Wizz Air BA better choice

The flight departed on time but arrived minutes late The legroom and comfort was OK The food is average The ground staff is helpful I would recommend this The inflight entertainment was fun and engaging The only major thing is the flight WiFi is bad

For one of the richest countries this airport is bad at all fronts Not organized rude security staff below standard lounges services This should be compared to Doha or Dubai Airport but they are light years behind even compared with the smaller yet much better airports in Muscat or Bahrain

From going into departures the man at check in never spoke and did not ask any security questions not sociable at all Did not stop there also in E Gates they were talking to people aggressively who were having difficulty using the new system Not going on holiday for that

This is an old military airport which has only a few daily flights It has a restaurant and a souvenir shop selling souvenirs you are unlikely to want Security is tight and photographs are not allowed My bag weighed more upon leaving than arriving and the only way to resolve this problem was to quietly pay a bribe less than the excess baggage cost The toilets were smelly the seating areas both landside and airside were sufficient for the number of passengers using the two gates The airport is totally disability unfriendly There is parking nearby for more cars than the number of passengers likely to use the airport It is close to the centre of town

Starting from the journey from Johannesburg the flight was delayed by hrs The return flight was even worse They cancelled the ticket and issued a new one for the following day On the following day we went to Checkin and we were denied boarding They said we didnt have a ticket even though they issued it We were stuck in Dubai in December now needing to book a new hotel find a new flight and no compensation from the airline even though they caused this problem Dont take Air Tanzania if you know whats good for you

Do not take this airline Over an hour delayed They lost my new baggage straps The cabin smells like jet fuel before take off and the staff wont speak English or Korean to you if you respond in English Ive flown with many airlines over the last years for work and leisure this is the worst one Ive used

This whole airport experience was a complete and utter joke The debacle began the second we left the plane where we were subjected to long queues and no apparent wifi connectivity The staff slap a sticker on you without consent and herd you like cattle to the transit area The best description of the transit area is a skeleton Yes it is modern and clean with the initial appearance of many shops and restaurants but spend more than minutes there and you will realise there is hardly anywhere to eat where the food is inedible and there is hardly anywhere to shop and the staff dont speak English So to pass the time we decided to splurge on entry into the airport lounge However we were told in broken English that they only accept Chinese yuan for entry Slightly annoyed we asked where we could withdraw cash or exchange foreign currency the staff member advised there was no ATMs nor currency exchange outlets in the airport So if you want to spend more than minutes in a place with barely any edible food a smoking room resembling a scene from Black Mirror Gulaglike environment covered with security cameras and that simply makes you hate life then I recommend a transit at Shanghai Pudong

Extremely awful slow service hourly waits and no internet These people hold us up about their microphone and then say they resolved it hours later when they just keep adding minutes to their issues I cant believe flying with them when I know I couldve been on my vacation already but Im still dealing with their problems

Glasgow to Lourdes this journey proved all the negative reviews I had read about this airline to be spot on Plane arrived at Glasgow four hours late after which we eventually boarded Our troubles were just about to begin After counting the passengers on the plane at least half a dozen times the cabin crew asked passengers sitting in the front seats to move to the back Caused great inconvenience and lost time We arrived at our destination approx seven hours late and five hours late going home

It is specific for Delta Airline Checkin process staff at JFK airport My flight was to Seattle on July afternoon pm I checkedin online before I headed to JFK Airpot and so I did not have too much time before departure time In security check point the officer told me that the birth date in my ticket My son booked the ticket for me It is hisour fault I know is not the same as that in my driver license So he asked me to go back to the checkin point for correction The waiting line in the checkin Maybe most of them are for checking in baggages while I do not have that day is super long If I lined up from the end I probably I will miss the flight So I talked to staff around the checkin area It was so crowded Someone said you go to there pointing Totally I talked to difference people around that area Still no one is responsible for my issue They were saying differently It seems I have to line up from the end In the end I stick on one lady She said I understand your situation I can do nothing about it She hinted me I have to line up again Finally I have to cut into the line by some peoples kindness to allow me to cut into the middle of the line I am OK to line up even it is long if I did not check in online I would leave more time to do that My question is For this kind of special situation should Delta Airline have some specific rules to handle would you like the custom to miss their flight Thanks

When arriving at the airport in a taxi I was met by a very nice viewing point for people to watch aircrafts taking off and landing My flight was from NQY to LHR when Flybe was still alive when I entered the airport there were check in desks and a caf right there so not at all difficult to find them when arriving with only hours of sleep at am I had already checked in online so I went straight into security which was very conveniently in the next room It took about minutes to get through security and into the Airports Lounge On first impressions it was quite small with not really much to do but what more can you expect for a local Airport There was only places where you could buy stuff in the departure lounge which was a caf and a Cornish shop that sells Cornish alcoholic beverages and other snacks and the caf sold quite a few things but I only got a water bottle which I think was around There were also toilets which were kept to a reasonably well standard and we boarded our flight with no problems and took off about minutes after departure time

Small airport checkin was quick and big smiles and friendly checkin agents Security took forever slow process and flight was early am departure so maybe that is why I cant imagine when KLM has a here and they are clearing people compared to a on Surinam Airlines Gate area is small and there are quite a few shops some were closed this early but when they are all open there are plenty of options No jetbridges so you get the experience of walking on the tarmac to your plane Toilets clean and prices in the shops reasonable Arrival is slow with immigration but bags were delivered quickly Plane parked close to the terminal and it was pouring with rain no umbrellas provided but wasnt too bad Airport is minutes from Paramaribo on a road with many speedbumps that is the biggest negative about the airport especially when your flight arrives at midnight and you dont get to your hotel until after am

Holguin to Havana last week Okay apart from issuing duplicate boarding cards to different passengers Return was in a turbo prop plane which was hour late and was infested by cockroaches running along the floor overhead lockers and electrical ducts The plane was generally dirty Obvious lack of maintenance

It seems very under used airport comparing the facility and the passengers go through here Its all new a couple years old with very long runway Arriving from CNX on Air Mandalays prop plane seems odd on this runway Its located pretty far out from Mandalay city center The airport seems deserted after all passengers left

The boarding process for our Air Canada flight to London Heathrow is currently ridiculous I am not sure who thought it was a good idea to board a flight to Frankfurt and London at adjacent gates with departures times mins apart It was crowded and hot with no place to sit My husband is ill and it isnt a good experience at all Comfort before a flight matters a lot These are two long international flights as well and it is an absolute cattle car in this tiny corner of E gate

The new terminal is just a large barn A few shops and very little duty free Airport staff disinterested rude and officious Border police just as rude demanding some sort of photocopied form from me which I did not have Yes I do speak Macedonian and I still could not work out what he was after Just as well we were leaving

Really disappointed with Split airport Firstly there were no trays to pass our items through security All the trays were stacked up on the other side and the attendant didnt think to send any back causing unnecessary waits Then the concession stand charged us for burgers fries and soft drinks They then charged us each per sachet of condiment Thats right euro for ketchup What a rip off Unfortunately Croatia has become a bit money grabbing recently and this attitude will not be tolerated long by savvy travellers

Flown this route return or times Of course a visitor to Guernsey has no choice the airline has a monopoly The flights themselves were only an hour and uneventful Aurigny flight team is usually OK Not rude but not terribly friendly either My last trip the Guernsey airport staff was a very bad dream They treated me like a suspected terrorist Im a pastmiddleaged solo female traveler Kept me until the plane was completely boarded I was the last one allowed on board They opened my suitcase and removed every single item They turned my book upside down and flipped the page looking for who knows what I fully expected sniffer dogs at some point Since the trip itself had been stressful horrendous weather hotel room robbed this last insult was so upsetting I was finally allowed on the plane but fighting tears The flight attendant was nasty and gave me a look for holding everyone up

Not going to repeat so many other negative comments that I agree with at Glasgow airport however I must raise the question again as to why the one hour only free wifi business utterly ridiculous Im now on a hour layover in Toronto and free wifi all the way all day at the airport why so tight Scotland when other airports are trying to at least offer free access while at the airport but not Glasgow shame on your stingy offer

Very quick visit through this airport its small and gets very busy but I did not encounter any issues Bags arrived on belt within minutes was out in mins Check in efficient small duty free shop kiosk airside security staff polite Am embarrassed to witness how rude some passengers are when using this airport They dont use bins for their litter talk rudely to staff and have an air of arrogance It will never be Changi but it works for the short time you are there

Security alert mayhem no one knew what they were doing People with priority pass and Emirates customers allowed to skip the security line while me and my two boys were held back in the mayhem missing our flight connection and part of our holiday Tried to explain that my flight was leaving to be told we are all in this together stay where you are Two emails sent as complaints not one reply Will avoid in future

When trying to find Gate at am all passengers were walking in circles as area was poorly marked that all Gates enter through same gate I started playing hostess so passengers could stop dragging their bags around Should be an easy fix with an extra sign or staff directing traffic

Almost no announcements in English during flight Plane very dirty like not cleaned for decades decaying couldnt eat the suspicious snack given Online checkin is actually not available for Air Algrie flights as you need to have your ticket printed in the old fashioned way Staff were friendly and professional but cant make it better with the airline theyre working to
Worst airline ever They dont give you food or water You cant even buy on plane Service were terrible Plane has no Tv monitor or charging station Seats are really bad but you still pay lot of money

Checked in online but still required to collect boarding passes at check in desk arrived hrs in advance still in queue with large portion of other passengers mins before scheduled departure plane theoretically boarding No time for food or toiletries at duty free Other passengers with mobility issues all of us having to rush through airport

This is one of the newer Indian airports though unfortunately unlike BLR BOM DEL etc you wouldnt know it Its handicapped by a design that was inadequate in size and not well planned While theres a fair amount of shopping it occupied so much space that the passenger concourse feels congested even on a lowtraffic Saturday morning The airport isnt particularly well maintained It looks clean but thats about it Service standards from the entry to the airportstaffed check in and boarding staff are remarkable by their lack of enthusiasm lack of politeness and lackadaisical pace of work If theyve had much training it was very inadequate

Ive checked in my luggage in good condition yet when I was returned with a spoilt luggage lock I was told its not under compensation The whole luggage is not usable anymore what do you mean by not compensable for damage lock Jetstar Asia is an irresponsible airline

Im supposed to fly to Zurich via LX today from London city airport The flight was cancelled suddenly without explanation I was given a redirected flight for h later I was told by the ground staff at the London city airport that I can get a complimentary meal pack from the airport either London City or Heathrow by showing my prior boarding pass I verified that I do not need anything else The airline provided a complimentary cab service to London Heathrow airport The fb facility at healthrow said that I need to show a meal voucher to qualify for the meal When I approach the Heathrow Swiss air ticketing counter which was a very long wait the staff said that theres no such a record for a meal voucher entitlement for me and tried to direct me to another staff then the Swiss air hotline This is a reflection of very poor service

The worst airline in the world in terms of dealing My husband and I traveled from Zanzibar to Entebbe and back on flight number UR from Sep I booked online seats with space in front of them because my husband has a broken leg and needs space to stretch it The airline employees changed the seats and gave us other seats without explaining the reasons or even apologizing knowing that the seats we booked were given to healthy young passengers They changed our reserved seats to other narrow one The plane is very small we can said is nothing more than a luxury bus its price is very expensive compared to the fare it covers and the services provided It has no advantage other than that it is a direct flight from Zanzibar to Entebbe I dont recommend traveling on this airline

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

I recently had a very disappointing experience with Air Arabia regarding their ticket cancellation and refund policy I booked a flight for my brother and paid an extra just to make the ticket cancellable Later due to unavoidable reasons I had to cancel the ticket Instead of refunding the amount back to my original payment method Air Arabia held the amount in credit points which is an unfair policy considering I had paid extra for a cancellable ticket When I tried to use these credits for my own flight booking I was shocked to find out that I couldnt use them because the credit was under my brothers name despite the fact that both bookings were made from my own account This makes no senseif Air Arabia is going to hold my money hostage in credit points then at the very least they should allow it to be redeemed within the same account regardless of the passengers name This is a highly restrictive and unfair policy If an airline is unwilling to return the money directly to the customer they should at least provide the flexibility to use it for future bookings regardless of passenger name as long as it is within the same account This experience has left me with a very negative impression of Air Arabias policies Instead of offering customerfriendly solutions they create unnecessary restrictions that ultimately cause financial loss and frustration for their passengers I would strongly advise anyone considering Air Arabia to read their fine print carefully before paying extra for a cancellable ticketbecause in reality your money might not be as flexible as you think I certainly wont be choosing them again unless they make their policies more transparent and customerfriendly Very disappointed with their refund credit policies

I booked a return flight from Lima to Cuzco two days ago and made the mistake of booking February March instead of March I called yesterday within hours and was advised that LATAMs policy was there is no penalty but I would have to pay the fare difference This sounded fair Especially as the fare online at their website was exactly the same for both trip dates Then they advised that the fare difference was USD I said this was almost exactly the same as the fare to book a new ticket so it is a penalty They said no it is just the change I called back to see if a more knowledgeable representative would get this right And got the same result Next as I live in Toronto Canada and the eticket was issued at their office here I walked over to their office the address on the web and on the ticket To my surprise LAN Air has never been there In fact the suite number they said they were at did not exist I will not rebook with LAN or ever fly with them again It will cost more but I will book with Avianca I fly more segments a year and will never fly on LAN again unless I absolutely have to I am glad that I learned this lesson on such a cheap fare Be sure to get your online booking right as my experience would show that there is no reasonable ability to adjust after you push enter

It would be bad citizenship if I dont write about my experience with Turkish airline If you plan to book a trip in which ones possible airline option is Turkish please make sure you have adjusted expectations I travel often from the US to middle east and tried different airlines This time I chose Turkish because it has sightly shorter duration on the longer leg compared to other service providers in the region Qatar Emirates etc But unfortunately I didnt get what I wanted shorter trip and also missed some other standard benefits With Turkish airlines you can happily book a flight and make travel plans accordingly But the airline doesnt feel obliged to commit to that booking They very very often cancel some legs of your flight likely due to the fact that the leg is not being fully booked This selfish cost saving approach wont stop there In my case it led to a major layover duration increase hr to hr And as you may have guessed they dont care for your time and wont even mention a penalty Having a hr layover I decided to book a lounge at Istanbul airport I wont bother readers with describing quality and variety of accommodations at the lounge But its good to change your expectation about a lounge if you think its supposed to be a comfy area for resting and good food If you could find a spot to rest like taking a nap you should be proud of yourself And lastly after all the misery we arrived at the destination Newark NJ with two out of five checked luggages missing Again it might be surprising to a regular reader but its very usual for Turkish airline staff if you ask them The airline had only seven hours to transfer our luggages and this is indeed error prone You may be more lucky with hr layovers next time Why am I writing this Just to vent a little Im sure the effect would be minimal But I also hope this helps some future travelers to dodge the bullet if they have other options

Avoid this airport if you have a wheelchair I travelled through Oslo airport with my year old disabled mother yesterday We flew in collected our suitcases and stood in line to recheck our bags on a British airline We had three hours and plenty of time to check in First the woman at the checkin was told by someone in Cargo that they wanted a photo of the battery Then they asked for some obscure information about the battery that we did not have and told us we could not fly unless we somehow produced a paper with the information My mother has been disabled for years and has flown several hundred times on flights in Europe and the USA with the same model of wheelchair she still uses Its a well known brand We have only ever been asked for the weight and dimensions of her wheelchair and the type of battery dry cell and how it turns off by key After standing there for an hour and a half another checkin person finally found some information online and we were told to go as quickly as possible to the gate I asked for help getting there as it was minutes before the boarding time I pleaded with the checkin person to get our suitcases on board they had been taken off the plane half way through this incident No help was given as we had to negotiate security the length of the airport and passport control by ourselves There was no time to use a disabled toilet which we knew from our trip through Oslo a week earlier had a broken seat and was dangerous which resulted in my mother not being able to use a toilet for hours she cant walk to use the ones on the plane This was a nightmare experience which only got worse when we landed at the next airport

I have to agree with the review below The security staff at this airport are extremely rude and aggressive They seem to take it as a personal insult if you show some initiative such as dare to pick up a tray yourself to speed up the baggage scanning process Move into an area of the conveyor belt that has space for three people but is only being used by one and you can expect a volley of abuse from a staff member The angry demeanour and lack of basic courtesy is absolutely astounding I dont expect much from airport security staff but these guys or some of them anyway fail to meet even minimal standards of acceptable behaviour

There is no signage to tell someone who has never been here before where rideshare is We did not see a sign for rideshare in the whole place until different people had to tell us how to get across the street Not even the Uber driver thought to say anything about where we were or why he couldnt find us while we watched people being picked up for minutes

Yaound Nsimalen is the worst obstacle course I have encountered Not content with the regular three hurdles of checkin passport control and security airport authorities have added multiple stops with random officials asking to see this or that document It starts at the airport entrance where you are required to show your ticket to enter Before reaching checkin your passport is taken from you and you are required to produce the visa for your flight destination even though you may be stuck in the queue some distance from his desk The journey from checkin to security involves filling in a departure form available from an unmarked desk producing proof of yellow fever vaccination even though LEAVING the country then showing boarding card and passport to another random official Security is inefficient and random Passport control involves waiting for a passport official to turn up often only one booth is occupied Once youre through youre not done you will be asked for your passport a couple more times as well as your boarding card There is a small restaurant on the air side but little prospect of accessing it since it would mean negotiating the dragon at the gate entrance again On the positive side thanks to the friendly Brussels Airlines staff member at checkin who made all the difference in an otherwise frustrating experience

I booked a flight on for On they decided to cancel without offering me an alternative flight I had to struggle till through their non responsive helpdesk and messenger to get my request for a refund acknowledged According to their internal rules they gave themselves generously a staggering days period to refund to the original payment method Now it is over days since their acknowledgement and over days since they canceled and they gave nothing They didnt bother to reply neither to my requests nor to my emails Everywhere you look in tripadvisor and trustpilot people got the same hassle and couldnt recover their money I regret having booked with them

It is extremely difficult to find your way around the airport due to lack of signages and there is no staff to help you They could have added direction signages every few meters Because of absence of signs You panic as you do not know where to go Toilets are very few Seating is very less Confused pax are milling about every where Lounges are not in the proper convenient places Duty free shopping is very limited and more expensive than even in other cities of Europe Dont expect to get any good duty free deal here

Old worlddescribes this airport in Southern Russia As with most flights in Russia passengers arriving on my flight were bussed to the terminal even though it was less than metres across the tarmac Let out and straight into the main hall to meet and greet where we had to wait until the luggage had been put on the conveyor then into a side room to collect our things As with all Russian airports and I seriously think this is a good policy you have to show your matching luggage tags before you are let out of the room Taxis are available of course or you can catch a bus to the eastern suburbs or just walk across to the main road its only metres if you want a bus in the other direction Didnt use it for departure so cant comment on things like checkin

After I booked a flight from Manila to El Nido I read a slew of bad reviews regarding last minute cancellations that are common with this airline And that was concerning to me but what could I do at that point Sure as heck hours before my flight from Manila was supposed to depart I received an email from Airswift saying my flight was cancelled due to maintenance issues as well If you choose to go to Palawan I would choose any other airline than AirSWIFT even if it means a long bus ride to El Nido

I recently flew with Iberia from Madrid to New York and back and my experience was far from satisfactory From the start the service was disappointing The staff were neither polite nor welltrained and their approach felt rushed and indifferent It seemed as though they were just trying to get through the flight rather than attending to passengers needs Adding to this there was a significant delay with the flight No clear or timely communication was provided about the reasons for the delay Once we finally arrived it took an unusually long time for the baggage to arrive and there was no apology from the airline for the delay Throughout the flight the crews attitude was unaccommodating and unsympathetic When I had concerns their responses were curt and dismissive which made the journey even more stressful Simple requests seemed to be a burden and any sense of hospitality was noticeably absent Add to this that the WiFi would not work with any of my functioning credit cards Overall this was a very disappointing experience Iberia needs to improve not only their inflight service but also their handling of delays and baggage delivery Better communication more efficient operations and welltrained empathetic staff would go a long way in enhancing the passenger experience Based on this trip I would be hesitant to fly with Iberia again unless significant improvements are made

Paris to Ashgabat Check in baggage allowance was kg not the that most others have Flight left on time full Plane new but no entertainment except map overhead Seats maybe cheapest Ive ever seen Like most planes rows near exit doors do not recline food was hot ok but definitely not the ritz No alcohol served Plenty of soft drinks If you are squeamish bring your own water and food and entertainment The big complaint was someone smoking and no one said a thing It stunk up the whole cabin Staff emotionless Price was cheap so value for the trip was ok Ashgabat Airport is new almost no one speaks English and definitely not French I went in expecting horrid and disastrous but all in all was a new experience

So few options for food when you have entered the departure area But the most annoying thing was a guy asking your opinion of the airport asking while eating not awaiting your answer while your mouth was full of food and all you had to enter was your personal information birth address activity at destination etc and not even one possibility to rate the facilities or anything of Bergen Airport They were just shamelessly collecting private information

The queues for immigration on arrival at local were long and disorganised no proper queuing system with snake line zig zag queue organisation A freeforall until you reach the short queuing system near the immigration booths none of the egates were working and no information The odd staff member looked disinterested and bored On departure the queues after security for immigration through B gate were very long hour wait with no organisation or communication the only staff member was calling for Irish passport holders who were able to jump the queue as they had EU passports I understand that the nonEU passport holders will have to pass relatively slowly through this process but to have gates with manned dedicated to EU passport holders and only manned for nonEU passport holders smacks of discrimination against the Brits on a massive scale There were flights between and on the departures board in full view of us in the queueing line all going to UK destinations I dont suppose my familys decision to change our holiday destination to a country that gives us the impression of welcoming us will change anything but it is a great shame as the Portuguese people we encountered on holiday were delightful and would be very concerned that the airport authorities are sending out all the wrong messages If the consensus amongst the people queuing alongside us are typical it will not be long before the owners of restaurants bars cafes taxis hotels etc notice a decline that will not be of their making The beneficiaries will be such businesses in destinations such as Turkey and Greece

This has to be the most inefficient airport Ive experienced Countless security checks Very limited seating which resulted in having to sit on the floor The cigarette smell looms everywhere in the airport

It is astonishing that Barbados Grantley Airport is still as unfriendly and disorganised as other reviewers described it years ago Although we were in transit we had to have all our belongings scanned again by customs and this was done incredibly slowly and with unfriendly harsh orders from the officials The most amazing thing was that they shouted at us because some of us were carrying rum in sealed bags from Grenada Duty Free They treated the people concerned as if they were serious criminals The bags were confiscated The people concerned asked what would happen to them now We were told that we would get them back at the gate At the gate the staff knew nothing about it They just shrugged their shoulders and kept the passengers waiting for about half an hour Then an employee set off slow as a snail and finally came back with bags He crawled off again and brought a few more bags Everyone got on the plane even those who hadnt got their bags back The crew finally took care of the matter and the rest were brought onto the plane The passengers were accused by the airport staff of not having listened However we were still unable to take off as the airports passenger system suddenly went on strike and several officials had to go through the aircraft to count us several times After an hours delay we saw Barbados getting smaller under the aircraft I will definitely not be returning to this inhospitable airport no way

A pretty mundane affair looks quite old and tired especially when you arrive Departure was fairly swift no long lines for security and staff seemed quite efficient Overall a very average airport but this is my only experience of a Japanese airport

I enjoy my visits thoroughly but the airport is quite tacky and very small The fact that you have to walk across the tarmac from the aircraft can be a pain for those who have a disability or are travelling with children etc but it makes for an authentic touch They have recently added a Burger King but the shops are very limited and if you are on a night flight all shops are closed The staff need to improve their customer service skills as they rarely smile and appear quite serious and some can be quite abrupt They need to some how stop the hustlers from crowding the visitors as they exit the airport trying to make a quick buck as it can be quite intimidating for first timers to the country but once you get through all this you almost instantly forget and enjoy your vacation surroundings

I booked with my husband FOR OUR vacation expecting us to be at least seated close to each other but we were seated four rows apart You can choose your seats by logging on hours in advance which I did and everything was booked up besides seats that I had to pay extra for I called their customer service and I was told if I wanted better seats I would have to pay Plus they make you pay for every single beer or food item for at least per beer and have no screens or internet Completely disgusted and I will never fly WestJet again

My biggest complaint is the actual building design I cannot believe how poor the design is whoever the architect was they had no foresight to the future How can you build an airport when arriving and departing passengers are exposed to the weather particularly in winter If you are being dropped off or picked up you have no protection from the elements if it is raining you will get wet entering or leaving the drop off points or trying to get or being dropped off It is an unbelievably poor design The whole building needs demolishing and a story building built the upper level for departing passengers and the ground level for arrivals whilst all under cover for pick up and drop off points The car park should be a under cover multi story It is time Perth Airport actually built a modern and feasable airport that will look to the future not just the next years Wake up Perth
