Tabriz is a small modern airport with easy access from city center Taxi costs only Euro I was at the airport hours before flight and there have been only one other flight in this period I was almost alone there and already start to worry as the check in for my flight starts only minutes before departure They have plenty of souvenir shops and one cafeteria Multimedia screens helps to kill the time All went smooth and fast No smoking rooms and wifi available

It took hours mins to clear immigration For over passengers there were only immigration officers This is a joke They want us to come and spend money and give us such a horrible experience from the time we land In this horrible immigration area there was no place to eat or have a coffee or smoke We stood in the line for minutes Then when we came out our bags were not yet there on the belt and we had to wait another mins for the bags Furthermore the free wifi never worked

Was on a full flight Check in was seamless and security was a breeze at Schiphol due to the priority security line owed to my FFQ status but this has more to do with KLM and its skyteam affliation than Korean Air To start boarding was efficient but flight was delayed due to airport congestion Nonetheless communication was on point and clear so I have no fuss Good leg room and meals as expected on KE for coach The parts where KE fell short this time around was their antiquated low resolution AVOD and this one passive aggressive crew that served my section Not really major but was slightly vexed by how spoken Korean was imposed on me by this one attendant due to appearances albeit being a foreign national of Korean descent and having spoken cogent English She just gave me bad vibes What was new about this KE flight was a snack station that was set up in the back galley Flown over a dozen flights with them and this was a first As mentioned food was good but repetitive as the menu seldom changes In summary this wasnt my favorite KE flight and not sure if dull is the right word but I felt the entire experience to be monotonous mechanical and uninspiring

Tiny airport stuck in the dark ages No night landing and the only flight into the airport regularly gets cancelled Very gloomy place to be stuck in with little information One shop one cafe selling expired packaged food beware and one TV set You simply walk between the terminal and the plane Baggage arrival is simply a large hall with a conveyor belt Best left for passing through this place

I live in Hannover and use this airport quiet frequently Despite its small size which should make it hassle free every time there is something which annoys me Either the lift and escalator to the train station is not working or there are long queues in front of security the WIFI is not working properly or the power plugs dont provide power Up to now I have never flown from here without a problem Arrival procedure is very good luggage usually comes within minutes Food and beverage is ok for a relative small airport Parking a car near the terminal is overpriced for short term from second day its almost same price then for a week Airport is easy to reach by train but it would be even better if the lift or escalator would work

The airport is clean and easy to go the price for the drop off is high as GBP And the security staff need to be educated to dealing with passenger Some are friendly but some are very rude and abusive They think to have all the power of the police

Passport control is extremely poorly and inefficiently run I entered a line which was clearly and unequivocally labeled as mixed that is for both EU and all passports After standing in line for minutes and finally getting to the passport control window the lady officer rudely told me that the line was only for EU citizens pointing above her head I looked up to see that indeed they had just changed the signs after I had waited all this time She did not care that the sign had just changed or that I had been waiting all this time She insisted that I go to another line where I had to wait for more minutes

First time being in Tasmania for a business trip I was first surprised by the tiny size of the airport There were no boarding bridges all you have to do is to walk across a bunch of walkways and that leads you into a corridor where they have dogs detecting food and anything that are not allowed to bring into TAS Then you will see the parking lot like meters ahead of you its that tiny All I know if that the Latte they offered there were pretty good There are several gift shops that sell a large variety of gifts snacks and books to read on your ride Something I found interesting is that the airplanes are not being pushbacked rather they park at sort of a degree angle to the terminal and when they are ready to depart they simply turn out onto the taxiway on their own power One thing I really disliked about this airport is that the wifi there are intermittent and the speed is the type that lags even when watching videos at p resolution Overall satisfactory experience and I would recommend it

My flight from Calgary was delayed due to a mechanical error I had a connection to Anchorage that I barely made due to the delay My disappointment was that I had paid for a premium seat and they gave it away to someone else They gave me a middle seat and told me I would have to call to get reimbursed for a credit That is very poor customer service Heads up the premium seats have more leg room but sit across and are narrow The inflight movie app did not work on my iPhone s nor did it work on my brand new lap top I would avoid this airline in the future

SanaaTaiz B on domestic halfhour flight Checkin the usual scramble to ward off people jumping the queue Once through formalities bussed to aircraft and funnelled through rear door in spite of only one or two passengers in biz Economy cabin was packed Passengers seemed to have been given generous hand luggage allowances resulting in crammed overhead compartments and stuffed underseats Light refreshment cold drink served nice touch given short duration Cabin attendants professional though not too smiley

Main airport to Philippines terminals squeezed round runways Terminal International Arrivals has airbridges and a shortish walk to Passport Control Important to get your eTravel declaration done before passport control usual baggage reclaim and customs check before getting out of the airport Very busy arrivals area with many taxi offering their services and congested parking directly opposite Terminal is mainly Philippine Airlines with a domestic and international section You have to show your passport and ticketBoarding pass to get into the terminal and get all your bags scanned Checkin Desks and a few other amenities before going through security The Departures Lounge is for domestic flights and separate to the International one A small selection of cafe and similar and gatesair bridges Limited seating means it can get very busy if a few flights go at a similar time There is patchy WiFi

Yangon to Mandalay Aircraft type changed from Boeing to E jet Flight time changed My last flight In September flight schedule changed without notice and so I have to buy new ticket with new airline It seems they dont have enough aircraft but sell the ticket So they arrange the schedule accordingly So not convenient not recommended for the passengers with important or fixed schedule or travel

Flight was delayed for more than minutes without informing the passengers A very small craft that doesnt tough the boarding bridge The airline provided connecting bus to the fleet Automated check in could be done though the machine was not working properly Ground Staffs and cabin crews were good in proving services Food was basic snack Ticket price was too high

Small but new building Departure checkin can be chaotic especially on routes within Africa but the international departure gate is spacious Note there are no services duty free or refreshments airside Arrival hyperstrict security Prepare for long delays and numerous passport finger print and visa checks Unlike other African airports however there is no hassle once you get out of the secure area There are not many taxis available and most are unmarked It is assumed that a foreigner will have already arranged for a drive The ride to the city centre is a quick minutes on a new highway

Terrible experience huge delays Its the third time flying with this airline and the service is unacceptable The staff was completely unable to inform us regarding the delays or deal with any of the comments of the frustrated passengers who waited over hours and another minutes into the still not moving transfer bus Definately would not recommend
Very crowded airport not sufficient seating arrangement jut like bus terminal not airport terminal feeling not proper food stall vending machine not proper work

Less than hours before the flight they moved the flight hours earlier from to which really inconvenienced me since I had plans for the morning before my departure I specifically booked this flight because of the time it was scheduled to fly although there were earlier flights available I have never experience a situation where a flight is moved earlier but also on such a short notice it is just ridiculous I arrived earlier at the airport Boarding started minutes after the plane was scheduled to depart And in the end the take off was delayed for hours

Very bad experience I faced in Reunion hour flight delay No one responsible in airport No proper food No proper lounge No proper WiFi Airport shopping is very costly Ground staff dont answer a single question And in between they dont know English

I feel compelled to write this review because the bathrooms at this airport when I flew out this morning th Sept about am are easily the worst I have seen in my entire flying experience of ten years The ladies bathroom close to gates was not only stinky every single stall was clogged and unflushed It is disgraceful for an international airport to maintain such pathetic standards I have seen the railway stations at Tianjin better maintained There were zero staff taking care of maintaining the restrooms This being an international airport I was so horrified to see this level of callous treatment of passengers When they announced my flight would be delayed I really prayed that it wouldnt be too long The airport guys ought to be ashamed

Antananarivo to Johannesburg This is the worst airline I have used The two flights I booked with them were both canceled on the day of the flight One was canceled due to mechanical problems on the plane only after everyone had boarded and was replaced by another flight hours later The other an international flight to Johannesburg was canceled with no explanation We were told that the next flight wasnt for a full week thereafter which would have caused us to miss our international flight back to the US The customer service agent could only offer me a call center email address for requesting a refund When I did so they told me they could only process the refund through my travel agent but I had booked the tickets myself on the Internet Canceling a flight and not refunding it is called stealing

In Nigerian standards relatively clean and organized However I was bored out of my mind when waiting for my flight because the shopping and entertainment possibilities is nil Overall and compared to Lagos domestic terminal this airport is paradise on earth

Took two domestic flights on Air Bagan one from Yangon to Bagan and another Mandalay to Yangon Both flights were with ATR aircraft The interior of this aircraft was very cramped with hardly any leg space The aircraft definitely showed its old age The flight from Mandalay to Yangon was free seated and flight was completely full The inflight service was nice and they served savoury croissants and cakes with drinks Regarding reservations the booking system is fairly tricky Also the airline requires the passenger to confirm the flights at least hours before departures Yet the phone lines are constantly busy For both flights our hotels repeatedly tried calling to no avail Air Bagan offers value for money because there is hardly any competitive alternative today

Reading some of the other reports of Almeria airport I have to say that I must have been lucky on the twenty or so times I have used the airport because I have not had any problems to complain about The only serious problem which needs to be highlighted is the pilfering of baggage which happens In view of the serious security problems at British airports someone in a foreign airport who can steal items from baggage could just as easily be putting something in Almeria to Stansted appears to be the main problem and whilst the pilfering could be taking place at Stansted this is unlikely due to the limited amount of time the bags are available to the people doing the pilfering The bags are out of sight at Almeria for up to hours before the flight

The small airport of Skiathos in Greece receives very few flights a day fortunately for us tourists It descends directly from the aircraft steps and you can walk comfortably hall for baggage claim after less than meters Given the few flights arriving at the waiting time for baggage is really ridiculous Inside the airport is just a small shop with a bar and cafeteria I must say that the organization of the desk is not exactly the best in my case there were two flights in that time slot and then the passengers were to form a single line across the airport to access the desk checkin in which there were only staff Once you checked in to access the waiting room for boarding where there is a small duty free selling tobacco magazines and souvenirs of the island There are sufficient seating for passengers waiting You can arrive directly with the car just outside the principal hall of arrivaldepartures So small but functional thanks to the reduced number of flights

I was very disappointed to learn that my checked In luggage was not loaded onto my PG flight out of Koh Samui After arriving in Dubai I lodged a Baggage claim with Emirates my nd leg of flight I was able to track my bag using my airbag and it sat at Koh Samui Airport for approximately hours from when I checked it in approx pm to getting an email about failing security check and asking for my combination so they could inspect it for a suspected lighter There is no lighter in the bag I dont understand why I couldnt have been contacted while I sat at Samui airport for around hours after checking my luggage in rather than me chasing them after I arrived in Dubai with no luggage They eventually contacted me via WhatApp asking for combination and explaining why it was not loaded onto the plane A very bad experience overall I am advised that I will now get my checked in luggage in the next hours So two days to get a bag from Koh Samui to Dubai

Love arriving in Canberra perhaps the exit sign could be more obvious though but it is so easy Loathe exiting though I have never not had a problem I am elderly female and I found it a tad offensive to publicly strip to my undershirt as apparently cardigans are a security risk and I was requested to remove mine I found this embarrassing I did remove my coat but seriouslycardigan Then my knee was an issue with their body scanner and I had to be patted down there My husbands ankle likewise I have travelled extensively and I feel Canberra staff are too aggressive and over zealous Perhaps they dislike the elderly as the young bloke in front of me was wearing a huge bulky jumper but that was OK There is no consistency between Australian airports what is ok in Melbourne is not ok in Canberra I think I will take some calming medication next time It is way too stressful Or maybe the manager can man up and watch to see what is going on

Good efficient airport but suffers from heavy summer traffic and due to the size of the airport there can be delays just due to the amount of flights which the airport can not handle Also not the best allocation of seats Security staff were very pleasant and polite Also not many cues or waits for security or boarding

Disgusting airport One terminal is nowhere near the rest of the airport No shuttle either You can either walk km in the heat with your luggage near the road and through a car park or take a bus for double the city fare No drinking fountains All prices are more than double the same restaurantscoffeeshops in town WiFi is for lounge members only or you have to pay for it Even at Starbucks you get an hour of WiFi for the price of coffees which is already double the price of Starbucks in the city

They switched my husband and I after we paid for seat upgrades and put us completely across the plane from each other in the very back We aid to sit up front Not a single customer service could help us This is absolutely ridiculous No offer of the refund was offered different people just shrugged and said oh well you are on the flight

Grenada to Guadeloupe via Barbados Do not travel on Liat with a suitcase Suitcase will not travel same time as you even with plane nearly empty it take more than days for the suitcase to arrive in Guadeloupe and been opened by flight company

Pula is one of my favourite airports to arrive to it takes sometimes min to get through I travelled to Pula in July and return experience was as usual quick swift and enjoyed the upstairs open space Arrival in September was the same The problem was the departure in September Transavia and Ryanair flights were one hour apart causing moderate number of passengers at the airport I arrived hr min prior to flight with hand luggage only and tried to pass the security There was nobody in the queue I was refused entry since the flight was not loaded on the system and asked to wait until h prior to scheduled departure This created surge of people at the exact time causing a queue at the security check without any social distancing measures At the ticket check after I had my boarding pass scanned I was asked to present UK Visas and Immigration document self isolation declaration to the airport staff There are two issues here and I hope somebody from the airport team is reviewing these comments As a healthcare professional and on the front line of COVID I am trying to distance myself The airport queuing system is doing exactly the opposite they are preventing a free flow of passengers and creation of queues I think this is a very poor practice putting at risk staff and passengers with large numbers of people without any good reason Another issue is being asked to present UK Government document to the airport staff I am following the rules and have paperwork ready but this is nothing to do with Croatian authorities and feel this is inappropriate invasion of my privacy I am afraid I hope this is a one off and next year we are back to normal

HORRIBLE Customer service The TSA lady was so rude over an honest mistake and shes yelling at me and my daughter She was so hyperfocused on pushing everyone through like cattle that she sacrificed basic customer service Yelling barking at customers making comments while walking past me without any regard for my response AND she barked at a fellow coworker in front of everyone Really set the whole mood for our trip Thank you TSA

We passed through LUN briefly on two occasions in September and found it to be a pleasant small airport with a couple of interesting features The first one was that when disembarking from a domestic flight one is led into the terminal building but the door to the main terminal is always closed so the person leading you has to knock on an adjacent partition wall to get someones attention to come and open the door We thought that was cute The second feature was the presence of a coffeecappuccino wagon in the terminal area dispensing a variety of freshly brewed coffees as well as freshly squeezed orange juice We thought that was a very civilized touch and considering there didnt appear to be any restaurants or cafes available that we could see at least that simple option was appreciated

Arrived on Windy Wednesday th Sept and am one of your bus travellers My experience of the bus shelter is always a cold piercing wind One has just got to look where it is located within the airport grounds The construction of glass panels with surround umpteen gaps like surround sound of howling and whistling makes for a very unpleasant time In particular on Windy Wednesday we had to wait a long time because our bus had been held up because of a fallen tree We were frozen but had to remain there in case the delayed bus arrived Also nobody came out to see if we were okay So why isnt the money we pay to get out of Knock used to redesign the shelter

They advertise on the plane that they are a Star APEX Company but the competition must have been terrible because I did not see even a stars approach on this trip Very small basic snack no wine no inseat entertainment standard seats ok there was a USB connection magazine in Chinese really nothing to write home about Good thing was that the plane left on time and arrived on time but this is the only really positive thing I can mention

Never fly with this irresponsible airline I am a travel agent and unfortunately I had to book many tickets with this new unprofessional Airline of their flights get canceled or delayed and no one is responsible either in the call centre or any office they dont have offices in most of countries

Absolute worst experience The flight was delayed over hours there is no hour line to call just got an answering machine Updates on flight status were almost nonexistent and there is nothing to do at the Paramaribo airport Staff was highly disorganized I had booked a continuing flight with six hours to spare figuring that was plenty of time The delay cost me to rebook my continuing flight and the claims department has been nonresponsive This airline is unacceptable as a national airline in any part of the world and if there is any other flight option I advise avoiding Suriname Airways

We were transiting through to Tokyo from London Gatwick Immediately upon arrival we were herded into a corridor with lots of other people trying to transit to other flights and given zero information After some time which we could have spent navigating the Airport independently we were herded to the transit section This whole process was a massive time suck and not needed it felt like they didnt trust foreigners to navigate the airport on their own The whole feel of the place is very eery We both felt on edge as they monitor everything with an excessive amount of cameras watchingrecording you constantly We had to endure so many painfully long queues that seemed illogical We were getting a transfer but we had to go through the exact same processes we had already cleared hrs prior in London Gatwick Our liquids and hand luggage was intensely scrutinised even though again we were cleared at London Gatwick We had to constantly show our boarding pass provide lots of personal information and photos constantly and it all felt quite invasive It felt like a massive overkill We thought having a layover of hours would be plentiful however we ended up after enduring the most surreal and stress inducing transfer weve ever been through with only mins to catch our flight It seems judging from previous reviews I was lucky to be able to buy drinks prior to getting our flight as we were desperately thirsty using my card but again I had to sign things and it was a very elongated process I am dreading our return journey No one speaks English they seem unconcerned about time pressures with flight transfers and while we saw quite literally over members of staff congregating at various points in the airport they have minimal staff processing flyers The presence of so many staff loitering around is also intimidating as is very intensive security procedures Ie everyone goes through the metal detector gate but noone escapes a pat down It so excessive and massive overkill You cannot access the free wifi unless you are prepared to give more personal info like your phone number or passport details with current photo and if you do take that deal everything is blocked unless its a Chinese website so massive issues of censorship here which is deeply uncomfortable I would not recommend unless you are into the vibe of a dystopian escape room

This airport is just sad It is such a beautiful facility that goes largely unused Largely abandoned by US Airways most of the stores close early now so that any travellers coming into the airport in the evening find virtually all food establishments and other retailers closed Many of the gates have been walled off as not necessary Its all just very disappointing for the Pittsburgh area

The airport was very crowded for the upcoming Memorial Day weekend Nonetheless there was plenty of seating at the gates and dining options ranging from sit down restaurants to fast food The terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Going through security was a breeze with TSAPre The Airport WIFI is easy to connect too and fast The major drawback to this airport is the lack of bathrooms The bathrooms are small and there are only stalls in each of the mens bathrooms On a busy travel holiday this meant waiting times of about minutes Given the number of passengers that fly through the airport daily renovating andor expanding bathrooms should be considered

Accra to Kumasi The flight was cancelled three times I book the flight pm which was more expensive than travelling in the evening but at long last I travel in evening which I dont like And when I was coming was the same cancellation also three times cancellation

Marrakesh airport off season is a breeze and my opinion may be different if I was arrivingdeparting with the European holiday crowd My biggest focus when traveling business class is an airport than can offer differentiating services for that class of service It was not clear on arrival if we had access to Fast Track and could not find much information about it but with the limited number of passengers queueing at immigration we just went with the crowd On departure we had a better experience Getting inside the terminal requires queuing with all passengers but we obtained access to Fast Track for security and immigration following our checkin at Air France business checkin counter There is a chocking point following immigration where all passengers converge but it was fairly quick considering the slow season Great shopping and an amazing little Royal Air Maroc full service lounge made the rest of our airport experience enjoyable One really concerning point The free airport Internet was not working well besides the light crowd I cannot imagine how bad it gets during the busy travel season

Small airport and rather run down but being refurbished with new buildings and new runway to take bigger planes Walk to terminal Staff very helpful Best to be at front of plane if you need to purchase Visa as can take a time Need to prebook transfers to hotels as a long way out of town and no public transport Check in easy although staff seem unable to book people or their baggage onto connecting flights so if going via Johannesburg you will have to enter the country via Immigration collect bags clear customs and recheck them at the International desks and then go through security and Immigration again Can take mins so allow time for that to happen Departure lounge basic and small no lounge for premium customers A few shops and one bar Short walk to plane on the airport

My wife and I were assigned seats separated so I asked the airport supervisor to arrange our seats to be close together She claimed that the flight was fully booked Later after we boarded the flight we found that some seats were empty When we booked the seats they were together

It is a modern airport built about a year or two ago Though small and only flying out domestic flights it is air conditioned and has a two shops and a restaurant Security and checkin was efficient and modern There is not a lot to do so if you get there early I hope you have a book to read

Malaga to Dusseldorf Regarding our return flight with Laudamotion departing from Malaga We tried to contact days in advance with both airline and ticket provider Both agencies did not respond by phone or mail Wednesday morning on March th we went to the airport anyway and our flight was not even mentioned on the information boards I understand all the commotion surrounding the coronavirus but it is shameful that customers are not informed at all and are simply left to their own fate Ultimately we were helped by Ryanair with a flight to Amsterdam The next day we Picked up our car in Dsseldorf We dont recommend Laudamotion at all

The flight was cancelled and rescheduled for a time that was inconvenient for our travel plans To reach someone at the customer service was almost impossible and I spent multiple hours trying to reschedule the flight The Citilink app didnt work properly as well It was a disaster At Lombok airport the company representative requested to pay additional fees for the same exactly luggage I brought from Bali to Lombok She refused to take my credit card payment and asked for cash only When I paid cash and asked for the receipt she said that can only provide pictures of the bills she took from me Try to avoid flying this airline

Delay after delay after delay every time Waste a whole day with them Madly expensive airport that insists on full security screen removing water and lighters even if youre transiting and purchased after security in a main hub airport

I flew from Denpasar to Amsterdam in December with a transit in Xiamen The flights themselves were fine but the transit in Xiamen is a hassle and not worth the lower price the airlines offers compared to their competitors On the route I flew the main competitors are KLM Qatar airways Emirates and Singapore Airlines To transit in Xiamen to your onward flight you need to clear immigration twice which means filling in a form queueing up cleariing immigration as if Xiamen is your final destination and you are entering China which I was not Some other travellers have reported being questioned by immigration WHY and even being held for an hour or so In my opinion this is unncessary and inappropriate Then also you have to go to the check in area again wait in line and check in separately for your connecting flight whereas it is common that you are checked in and receive boarding passes for all your flights at the point of origin I have sent an email to Xiamen about this and am awaiting their reply For now I will not fly with them again until the transit procedure has been changed to not require going through immigration and checking in separately for a connecting flight None of the competing airlines mentioned require these things allowing for a more pleasant experience and more time to relax and use airport facilities

Budapest to Paris via Prague with CSA Czech Airlines The flight started with an hour delay Before landing in Prague I Was asking about my luggage if it will arrive on time to the next airplane Of course sir bla bla it did not arrive Very uncomfortable feeling to travel without luggage

Strict levels of security bordering on the obsessive Luggage is scanned twice You are searched even if the metal detector does not go off as you pass through it It is understandable Beware of possible ripoffs at the DutyFree Shop They can give you the wrong conversions from euros to Uzbek sums if you want to pay in local currency

The Internet connection is timed to minutes and so bad mobile is far superior theres not enough seats and those that are there are extremely uncomfortable hard plastic with dividers No quiet zones low temperature makes you catch cold and then theres the staff The service is forced and makes you feel bad for even ordering anything and dont try resting at any of the restaurants better chairs theyll call security even in the middle of the night Reason Well who really knows maybe they like seeing people resting on the cold floors since theres not enough seats Theres even a dedicated announcement just to remind there are thieves If you can avoid especially if you have to lay over pay a bit more and choose one you know to be peoplefriendly

Kiribati is a very small country and as expected the main airport Bonriki Tarawa is very small It is about the size of a very small warehouse but it was undergoing rerefurbishment Being a very small airport the staff were very friendly After checking in and having passed immigration you have no option except to go out of the airport and hang about until boarding time which I found rather charming There are no facilities other than clean toilets but nothing matters in this Paradise of a country
hours at custom check point That never happened to me before One person helping over people Will never go to that airport again for an international flight

Flying with this company was an awful experience seats are so close that practically you breath on the neck of passenger in front of you staff quite cheeky and unable to offer reassurance to distress passengers who had to endure a long flight just to be told that they cannot land in cluj due to heavy fog we had to land in Bucharest and wait people were obviously very tired and staff didnt help not even with water when passengers asked Their answers were cheeky and dont know the meaning of politeness or costumer service manners

Denizli ardak Airport is a small regional airport for the city of Denizli with flights to IST SAW and Iran The airport is quite small with the ability to hold aircraft at a time Shops are scarce with cafes souvenir shops and one suitcase shop The main reason people come here is for Pamukkale which is a natural wonder The cafes are good for a quick snack but nothing more Arriving one hour before the flight should be enough as security lines are no longer than ten minutes

They book you at a price lower than their competitors but tell you at time of booking you only have to pay for your seats When you get to the airport they charge an astronomical amount for checked bags and for carryons All you are allowed is a backpack On the plane you cant get a glass of free water on a hour flight You have to buy a horrible dinner for and water is a bottle Seats are uncomfortable and crew was not nice to me By the time you add all the charges on you would be better off flying Delta or American and getting a decent dinner then breakfast along with pillows and blankets Norse didnt give you free headphones on a hour flight You had to buy them

I recently flew business class on Turkish Airlines from JFK New York to Istanbul and unfortunately my experience was far from what I expected The aircraft felt outdated with uncomfortable seats The cabin temperature was unbearably high turning the entire hour flight into a sauna While the food was passable I found it below the standard of other airlines business class offerings My connecting New York to Rochester flight was canceled with no assistance from Turkish Airlines No automatic rebooking No refund or apology I had to book a sameday ticket on a different airline at my own expense just to get home Reaching customer service was a nightmare they were dismissive unhelpful and indifferent Each call ended with them simply asking me to leave feedback on their website Emails were ignored and when I finally spoke to a ground agent they were rude and uncooperative Despite multiple attempts I received no refund no compensation and no resolution This level of service is unacceptable especially for a businessclass passenger I will never fly Turkish Airlines again

Their new terminal looks far from finished and the existing buildings are probably what youd expect in one of the worlds poorest countries At immigration people from back in the queue kept being prioritised through and we were asked for a tip from an official loading our luggage through the scanner Random officials asked for our documents for no apparent reason and we fought off some very aggressive people wanting to assist with our luggage Checking in was fairly chaotic not helped by the lack of space The ATMs worked and many people looked to be working hard to make this place function but overall Ivato airport gives a dreadful first impression to anyone coming to Madagascar

Having recently travelled a bit domestically in Australia I want to give a big shout out to the security team at Adelaide Airport which is in complete contrast to Melbourne In Melbourne going through security screening is about as unpleasant as it can get principally due to the staff attitude Complete opposite in Adelaide There was someone available and proactively helping people load to tubs with their carry on item being pleasant and professional about it and if something concerning detected not making the passenger feel like they are an obvious security risk

Security TSA checkin needs a remodel non district missing information A narrow hallway Seating in boarding area poor Seats torn walls in need of TLC Entire area needs a new property manager only nice open clean area was the car rental area

This is the first time I have ever travelled through Gran Canaria airport and I must say its a pathetic excuse for a departure lounge They are renovating the departure lounge but I am concentrating on the area already renovated They have no idea what good service is if they think waiting minutes to be seen in Olearys Or minutes in Burger King is what travellers expect then they must live on cloud cuckoo land They have made some nice restaurants in the refurbished area but tended to plan in adequate seating Really the airport is a prime reason to never visit the Island which we wont be

I returned home to Cape Town with my husband my year old mother and my year old twin boys on June Our flight landed just after am Passport control was overcrowded overwhelming and chaotic There was no queue for elderly people not in wheelchairs or for families with young kids I found this problematic as our kids starting having major meltdowns in the queue that was miles long We tried to call a staff member over to ask if there was any way we could avoid standing in this long queue with my kids and my mother The lady told us to come with her to the front by the counters but we had to all crawl under the metal bars to get there After a few minutes after she had spoken to her supervisor she told us that she was sorry but we had to stay in the queue as the supervisor said if he allows it for us he must allow it for everyone Shouldnt this be the norm though Making provision for families with elderly parents and young kids I found this so hard to understand and felt very frustrated at this point We had to then rejoin the queue and when I asked if my mother could at least go through a gate we were told no When i asked if my mother could sit and wait on a bench until we reached the front of the line we were told no So we all had to climb back under the metal bars to get back into the queue After having lived in many countries and after travelling through a lot of international airports I have to say that Cape Town International Airport is far far behind in terms of international standards Very disappointing to arrive home and to have this experience I am not looking forward to departing from or arriving to this airport again in future

As this is inside my body it is near impossible to take it out Due to the nature of this device I have been advised not to go through metal detectors as it could trigger my device into action and as such I contact the airport before flying to do so explaining I will be carrying my Patient Identification Card on the flight which gives the information in English French and German This normally is suffice information and when I inform a member of staff at an airport they allow me to come round the side of the metal detector to be searched by a member of staff However when doing so at Katowice I was rather rudely told to put my Identification Card in the tray with my bag while I was trying to explain to another staff member what it was and why I couldnt go through I was told to go through anyway and it would be fine As expected my device did set off the metal detector and I stepped aside to be searched On being searched the staff member felt where my ICD was and asked me to take it off despite it being inside my body I explained how it was inside my body and couldnt be taken out and while he seemed to understand this my body search seemed a lot more rough than normal I felt this was a very inappropriate comment for a staff member to make and I was very disappointed at the way I was treated by the staff almost with suspicion While I am fine with flying now the first few times I did so I was very nervous and grateful for the support given by staff members who I explained my situation to My worry is if someone else travelling for the first time was treated like this they may have a panic attack at the airport and be reluctant to travel by plane in the future

I recently flew from Dhaka to London with Saudia and upgraded to business class for the Dhaka to Jeddah leg of my journey Unfortunately the experience was far from what was promised and turned out to be one of the worst airline experiences Ive had Saudia Airlines advertises a dedicated checkin counter for business class passengers yet at Dhaka airport the business class counter was unmanned Meanwhile economy passengers were being checked in smoothly I had to wait minutes speak to multiple staff members and go through unnecessary hassle just to complete my checkin At the boarding gate there was no separate queue or fasttrack service for business class passengers Everyone was forced into the same long line waiting over an hour just to board the flight After passing all the required airport security checks I was shocked to find Saudias own staff conducting additional baggage and body searches at the airplane gate I was forced to open my carryon luggage in front of strangers The flight crew were shockingly unprofessional and rude they struggled with basic English The inflight entertainment system did not work throughout the journey I paid a significant amount to upgrade to business class yet I received none of the premium benefits promised From the chaotic checkin to the lack of priority boarding unnecessary security checks and unprofessional service this was one of the worst flights I have taken

Id love to able to write something positive about this my local airport but alas this isnt the occasion Travelling with my son who is autistic but in no way challenging in his behaviour we came up against the most officious security officer in the passenger search area My son was wearing his highly visible autism puzzles wristband which proclaims they are working in partnership with Cardiff Airport All was progressing well until the officer demanded my son push a tray being used by another passenger forward into the search machine My son had already pushed his own tray forward and was confused by this brusque instruction and when I interceded the officers response was it wasnt his job to do this He then petulantly turned on me demanding I empty my pocket as this sharp eyed Sherlock had observed a handkerchief which he insisted must be xrayed This experience encapsulates the mountain CWL have to climb to rid themselves of the entitled and self important attitude which is now all pervasive since they were recipients of the ill judged handout from the Welsh government It is difficult to avoid the conclusion that CWLs desire to facilitate the travel of disabled passengers is nothing more than a shallow marketing exercise which clearly hasnt been communicated effectively to their staff

After long trip from Copenhagen we about passengers were directed to funny bus packed to the limits and very hot We did arrival at what looks like United Airlines hub We are Global PassTSA members so we got our face screen and after we had to pickup our luggage to place it back on the conveyor for transfer There was no screening no one checking why we had to do this After we were directed to TSA check why We did our Global check which should include TSA After a long wait we arrived in terminal where we had to walk fast the full length of terminal to catch our connecting flight There was no place to sit and most of the restaurants had long waiting lines For anyone specify for ones arriving for the first time in USA this Capitol airport is total embarrassment It looks old dark and dirty Airport management needs to invite Secretary of Transportation to visit this place as a regular passenger without any preparation for his visit

Half the terminal has been demolished to make way for the new terminal under construction Bit of a shock on arrival but should be fabulous when finished Befitting a gorgeous island such as Rarotonga Previously RAR didnt separate Arrivals and departures bit of a problem for the once weekly flight tofrom LA No airbridges in the new terminal planned from the renderings I could see So still a bit of a problem to from aircraft when a tropical downpour arrives as it want to do Reason being this is such a tiny aerodrome with short runway of approx m just enough for a Accordingly turnaround and parking area for aircraft precludes a fixed airbridge New departure area will still have the outside garden area so you can have one last look over the airfield to the beautiful mountain peaks before boarding On another note duty free no longer the stupendous bargain it once was Still pretty good compared to many big airports around the world Happy to see such a new terminal being built but also a shame that Raro is geting all grown up Hope the new terminal can retains its island feeling

Holguin is a small airport not used to more than movements a day so when things go wrong they simply dont have the staff to sort out the problems I experienced delays in both my inbound and outbound flights so I got to see a lot of the airport Immigration is a major hold up since they are very thorough at checking and have few staff I went through the gates times and each time spent over an hour in the queue The departure lounge is small but with plenty of seating and an excellent view of the apron and runways from the observation balcony upstairs There are a few shops and a money exchange kiosk that changes money at the exact rate ie it doesnt charge commission There are two bars serving food and drink but this being Cuba the food selection is limited I was there for days and all they had was cheese and ham rolls for the entire time Overall its a pleasant enough place for normal transfers but you wouldnt want to spend a lot of time there Expect to get wet if its raining as the covered airstairs the busses and the terminal building all leak during heavy downpours

I had to pass through Kunming airport on my way to Thailand It was simply for a layover flight but our layover was hours Given that the purpose of our vacation was not China we didnt wish to deal with the hassle of leaving the airport We assumed that being in an airport for hours there must be some place to sleep right Well we discovered the rest lounge on the bottom floor it was full of uncomfortable chairs that do not recline and cannot be moved I did not wish for both me and my partner to be asleep in an unfamiliar airport and country at the same time so stayed awake away while he slept Our hours was from pmam the next day so the middle of the night The rest area was filled with visitors who were loud all throughout the night very hard to fall asleep We moved to some chairs that were actually more uncomfortable than the first but we could move them against eachother and actually lay down Well that worked until the literal police awoke us at am as they came towards us on segways and yelled at us and made us move the chairs back We drifted upstairs in search of refuge We found a sleeping lounge I gladly was ready to pay money for a wink of sleep they would not let foreigners use the sleep lounge You would think that at an international airport they would have an option for foreigners to get some sleep in a situation such as ours All of the kiosks were closed we couldnt figure out how to use the ATM which was fine our fault but when we asked restaurants if we could use our cards they yelled no At us and turned away When the kiosks did open up they sent us from one counter to another for about hours Never giving us a straight answer we were very sleep deprived and simply trying to get answers Finally we got an answer as to where we could checkin and then they changed it on us different times We ended up sleeping in restaurant chairs guarding our things until we were able to checkin I understand the airport is located in China but for a foreigner at an international airport I was very displeased and baffled by the quality of service Will definitely never be scheduling a flight through Kunming airport ever again

During my transit in Dubai on a Riyadh to Multan flight their staff demanded a fee for my laptop bag claiming only one handcarry was allowed When I resisted and asked for a supervisor they changed their tone acting as if there was no issue This kind of behavior is unacceptable and feels like an attempt to exploit passengers I do not recommend Flydubai for South Asian destinations

I took a connecting flight from London through JNB to Malawi We had to collect our luggage and check in again for the connecting airlink flight The queues for the passport check were very long and there were insufficient staff who were unfriendly We had four hours for the transit The monitors with flight details were not updating so we couldnt find which gate to go to The staff did not know Due to long queues at security baggage and passport we had only mins in the terminal before boarding Thats about hours waiting in queues Most of which was in hot sweaty lines with no working AC Security and passport and flight detail systems failed at different times Worst and most inefficient experience of a major airport so far I think we were unlucky to experience multiple system failure but modern airports should have decent backup systems in place

I flew from Denpasar to Amsterdam in December with a transit in Xiamen The flights themselves were fine but the transit in Xiamen is a hassle and not worth the lower price the airlines offers compared to their competitors On the route I flew the main competitors are KLM Qatar airways Emirates and Singapore Airlines To transit in Xiamen to your onward flight you need to clear immigration twice which means filling in a form queueing up cleariing immigration as if Xiamen is your final destination and you are entering China which I was not Some other travellers have reported being questioned by immigration WHY and even being held for an hour or so In my opinion this is unncessary and inappropriate Then also you have to go to the check in area again wait in line and check in separately for your connecting flight whereas it is common that you are checked in and receive boarding passes for all your flights at the point of origin I have sent an email to Xiamen about this and am awaiting their reply For now I will not fly with them again until the transit procedure has been changed to not require going through immigration and checking in separately for a connecting flight None of the competing airlines mentioned require these things allowing for a more pleasant experience and more time to relax and use airport facilities

Avoid this airline at all costs We booked a flight with them and a few days after booking the cancelled and rebooked our flight to days earlier That obviously didnt work for our itinerary and I asked for a refund They claim the refund process takes weeks To be eligible for that refund they require that you fill out additional forms including sending them bank account information Im also incurring hundreds of dollars of extra costs having to rebook other flights around this one I will never be booking with them again

I have never complained about Luxair although I would have many reasons I am travelling a lot with this airline and now I have had enough My flight from London has been cancelled it happened already of cases and despite there was an earlier flight they rebooked me on the latest I asked why some people were rebooked in the earlier but they said was random That is not true One BIL employee has been rebooked on the earliest flight and it is not by chance You are not customer obsessed you are one of the most terrible airline companies

The catering on this flight was appalling and an embarrassment to the airline The passenger seated beside me and I both chose the pork belly as the main dish on the recommendation of the flight attendant The salad entre was a tiny portion and the ingredients bizarre The main course looked terrible and tasted worse The pork was fatty grey in colour and over salted the rice congealed and the broccoli cold The red wine was served ice cold The decision to serve prosecco rather than French Champagne given the flight experience is targeting holiday makers is baffling The only snacks available were potato crisps and crackers There was no choice with the prearrival meal and like the one on departure was inedible The passenger beside me and I were never given a choice but simply given a ridiculous plate of roasted pumpkin with melted cheese

This airport is a guaranteed waste of time Domestic flights connecting east to west or vice versa are often dropped off on the tarmac in terminal A with minutes to exit the plane wait until you load on the lethargic bus driver inch to the ramp for not the terminal and sprint a mile to terminal Dfor instance Good luck making your connection Between the way they have connections physically spaced and how closely they are scheduled its like they are actively working to prevent connections I am rescheduling all my flights to avoid this airport

I am a disabled lady travelling with my husband who is my Carer We arrived hours before our flight as advised by Ryan Air We sat and waited an hour before help arrived One lady pushing two wheelchairs for different flights We passed thru check in security and then arrived at passport control at the gate where my husband was told this is as far as you go with your wife now you go to the gate and you will see your wife on the plane We said he should be with me as my carer but was advised this was not allowed at Bergamo I was whisked away to a lounge which had a large room and a small room I was put in the small room in my wheelchair along with many others a tv was blaring away The staff were stretched out in the larger room watching tv I needed the toilet but my husband wasnt there to help so had to struggle my way to it When I came out I saw my flight was boarding in minutes I was told My husband phoned me and said he was on the plane I was then fetched and was pushed and shoved to the lift outside then had to wait while they fetched other disabled passengers Then was again shoved and pushed on to the lift I felt degraded There were four of us for different flights We got to my flight who was waiting just for me My husband was frantic wondering where I was and what was happening We were so late he thought the flight was leaving without me I have never been treated so inhumanely It was a disgrace you do not treat disabled people like this in the modern world I had no idea what was going on I rely on my husband for all things and you removed my only support I was in tears Bergamo and its staff need to improve

It is extremely unfortunate that the residents of the Cayman Islands paid such a significant amount of money for this airport remodel We departed Grand Cayman on Saturday March and it was absolutely horrible No place to sit waited in line for minutes for a bottle of water There are currently no restaurants or bars to have a drink at before departure The departure hall was packed wall to wall The air conditioning was obviously not size properly for the building and the amount of passengers We had a similar experience on our arrival We stood in line for over an hour to get through customs and immigration I have to say bring back the old airport it was actually better

Problem airlines Every time I decided to fly with them I struggle with problems I made a booking on July for a flight from HCM to Ha Not this September This August they have been bought by Vietnam Airlines and changed their name now Pacific Airlines They had to change all bookings previously made By entering our booking in their new system they made a mistake with the name of my fiancee they forgot her rd name I shown them the proof I have put the right complete name when I made the original booking and the mistake came from their end They did not care at all and ask me to pay for another ticket We refused to pay and it took h to bargain with them and make the name modification without paying any fees for their mistake Fortunately the ground service in HCM airport were fully understandable and made their best toward for us to do not pay any additional fees

This airport is disgusting The bathrooms are filthy with urine and unworking flush mechanisms Floors throughout terminal appear to rarely get swept or mopped Im amazed the airport can pass a foodservice inspection We ate breakfast at the wendys and the seating areas and tables had spilled drinks and food all around the dining space Trash overflowing It seems the cleaning crew are non existent or inept Avoid this airport at all cost Tsa was friendly and efficient but the rest is a zero

I arrived at Mackay airport at pm for pm flight to Townsville I went to the bar and got a drink and then at pm I went back for another only to be told the bar was closed There were still incoming and outgoing flights and other people were also wanting drinks There was no signage to advise of the closing time I thought this was very poor On the start of a long weekend we could not even enjoy a couple of alcoholic refreshments to start our holidays

Bastia to Stansted Group of flying as a family At checkin Air Corsica staff mixed up baggage tags so they did not correspond to the correct individual Air Corsica then decided not to load a full trolley of luggage on to the flight to ensure it was not delayed out of bags did not arrive at Stansted within our family alongside numerous other families that were also missing bags We proceeded to inform staff but as the luggage tags were on incorrect bags due to incompetent staff we could not make it as clear as it should have been on the missing bag forms out of bags arrived within working days Our bag has never been recovered Air Corsica have then proceeded to make it impossible to track it down or receive a refund for lost luggage Website does not allow you to save or upload correct information so times we had to restart our request They refuse to speak English on the phone After we finally processed the refund request they sent one reply saying the bag had been returned and therefore the case was closed They then closed the request without even contacting us and so we therefore had no way of appealing this The bag has never returned We have now had to go through our insurance provider but even this is being made difficult as they arent even able to get hold of Air Corsica and as our luggage tags were incorrect we are having to speak to multiple insurance providers that we took insurance out with even though it only affected one of us We flew in September are now in February and are still trying to receive compensation for our luggage

To avoid extra cost for the seat reservation my elderly parents both over and my mum is disabled completed the online checkin registration h prior departure They were allocated seats far apart and Once they boarded they noticed that the plane was approximately only full because there was only one passenger per three seats When my mum asked to sit next to my father as the seats next to him were free she had a very rude reply from the flight attendant hinting something about them being mean and not spending extra money for seats reservation

Flight at pm was delayed over and over again on June Then after it was finally cancelled There was no help at the counter The Customer Service line is useless No one answers and after you wait for minutes then it disconnects the call I called first thing in the morning today and they did answer the phone I was moved to todays flight at pm Same route Less than minutes later they emailed me a delay message for pm And another delay and another delay Then pm with the flight arriving hours later Now I received another message and the new departure is pm today I have written and called and no one answers Absolutely the worst experience I have ever had with an airline Horrible

Bristol Airport has gone downhill There was a local pandemic only recently yet the place is absolutely filthy Toilets cafes and general floor area is terrible We travelled to Nice airport and Toulouse airport recently and there is zero comparison A complete embarrassment The management need to enforce some rules for the cafe owners and also should take a look at some other airports to realise what a pit Bristol airport is

The security control at the airport was extremely slow A female security officer had taken a role to rearrange all the items passangers had put into the plastic crates literally organising them in the box to her liking for no obvious reason This meant that time per passanger was extended hugely When finally my time came and I had passed the control I took my crate to the adjacent table to avoid jamming the short end of the conveyor belt this triggered another security officer to come and inform that since I was using that table it obliged him to do the swipe test for explosives Alright nothing against that Before he finished the test the same ubermeticulous woman came to claim the crate back which would have been returned without her colleague intervening already long before as I had only three items in there and then they decided to start mocking me and joking that I probably wanted to keep the crate as a souvenir I felt completely bullied as in those situations you are on the mercy of them letting you go or keeping you behind Mind you during the entire security check process I had not made any remarks not shown any emotions or otherwise provoked them After I was cleared I asked a nearby police woman if she knew where the supervisor of the security control is to be found She kindly went to get a middleaged man from the line to me and he confirmed to me to be the supervisor but did not present his name or rank or anything He simply stated that all the procedures in Dresden are dictated by police order to detail which they simply execute He was not ready to admit anything else but the fact that Dresden is different from all other airports I was disturbed an frequent traveler I have never ever experienced anything like this

I recently had a frustrating experience with Alaska Airlines First you cant check in at their kiosk instead you have to sign in and scan a QR code I paid baggage fees but never received a receipt To get it you have to scan yet another QR code but even after I did it didnt work Ive called customer service four times to resolve the issue but each time Im transferred or put on hold indefinitely with no resolution As a frequent traveler for work I can confidently say that Alaska Airlines customer service is among the worst Ive encountered Very disappointing

Worst airport ever Arrived for a pm flight to Hanoi Have flown domestically out of Chiang Mai a dozen times Assumed there would be a similar level of food outlets in international as domestic There is nothing You can buy minute noodles and a soft drink No restaurant no fast food no bar Travelling with a hungry cranky child

Agree with other reports that this airport lacks most of the conveniences which a frequent traveller expects What is worse is that the Airport authorities dont take any of these comments seriously Even frequent travelers qualifying for a lounge are disappointed as the lounge lacks free drinks free food and internet access The staff just does not care Avoid this airport if you can

days ago we already had a delay of hours from Almaty to Astana where we had to offboard the plane and change planes Now going back to Almaty we already got mails telling us the flight will be delayed already more than hours I am getting the idea we will not fly today What a bad first experience with Air Astana

I will never purchase a flight ticket from them again as they are irresponsible Refusing to do a refund now and theyre telling me they cant find me in the system Basically lost my money and voucher because it is expired

The issue arose on the last day of our trip during the checkin for our return flight Our seats initially assigned to row were unexpectedly reassigned to row without any prior notice or explanation Despite our efforts to resolve the matter with a supervisor it was revealed that someone had paid for our seats resulting in our displacement What right do SunWing have to sell our seats I argued that I wanted to buy my seats back or I should get compensation for selling my seats The situation escalated further when an agent abruptly ripped our boarding passes After I was able to deescalate the situation since other family members were involved our boarding passes were reprinted To our shock upon reaching the airport security checkpoint we were surrounded by police who informed us that we would not be allowed on the plane The reason given to other family members was that SunWing had overbooked the flight a fact was unknown to us until our return to Canada Upon seeking clarification from SunWing agents the agents refused to engage with us Another unnamed agent accused us of posing a safety threat to an international flight threatening to involve the police and even mentioning potential imprisonment invoking the specter of terrorism Attempts to record the conversation were met with threats of arrest In the end we were forced to rebook our flights by ourselves for the following day The subsequent travel with WestJet was uneventful emphasizing that the issues were specific to our interactions with SunWing This experience was deeply traumatizing for my family and me Selling our seats to make extra profit at the expense of compromising the comfort and safety of my family is unacceptable Having a group of agents controlling who boards the flight is not only unacceptable but must be dealt with immediately We have been traveling for many years with no concerns as a Canadian I shouldnt feel like a criminal in a foreign country especially by agents representing a privately owned Canadian company

A very clean airport but with often absent and very rude staff a trait that we now know to be common in Turkey and Turkish Cyprus There is a great lack of any English signage or translations of announcements Hardly qualifies as an international airport on that score On arrival we had no idea which of the bits of paper we had to fill in to avoid the stamp in our passports and on departure we sat ourselves by the gates and watched faces that we knew were to be on our flight so we wouldnt be likely to miss the plane The duty free is very strange in Ercan instead of a large shop selling everything there are loads of little shops all selling much the same thing Despite Turkey and TRNC still having their own currency and being very keen to get their hands on Sterling and US Dollars the prices are all in Euros although mostly there are no prices on anything and you have to ask This maked it very hard to compare between the various shops And you also fall foul of a sneaky trick you never get a price quoted in Turkish Lira they tell you what it is in your own currency but what you dont realise is that they have converted it using the bank rate which is not at all favourable Never use your credit card in Turkish Cyprus because they also charge extra and by the time you see the amount on your statement its likely to be a fair bit more than you thought Having said that though if its alcohol and tobacco you are after the prices are very cheap and even better than in the normal shops One further warning beware of the luggage trolleys They all work perfectly no wobbly wheels etc but they give you an electric shock when you start moving them Heaven knows what is in wheels or in the floor covering but I got a shock on arrival and again on departure A fellow traveller told us that it happens a lot

Flew tofrom Shreveport on United Express After picking up my checkin luggage from baggage claim I went outside the terminal and did not find any Taxis When I did spot a Taxi the driver asked me to call his company reserve and then they would dispatch someone to pick me up In short taking a taxi from Shreveport Airport takes significantly longer than most airports When returning I arrived at Shreveport Airport hours early due to potential delays at the airport Apparently there was no one at the United ticket counter When an agent came she told me that I arrived too early Overall the security lines at Shreveport are short boarding areas are compact and dining options are limited after security The primary reason why I cant recommend this airport is due to the serious inconvenience caused to passengers who cant find any cabs readily available at Shreveport Airport

When driving to the airport there is an fee collected at the entrance to the airport parking grounds The fee I believe was DJF they will accept USD as well a slightly worse rate Once inside my passport was checked and stamped with ease and I was upstairs awaiting to go through security The small bar prior to security has very little to offer but did have some good Ethiopian beer WiFi was hit and miss and the mosquitoes were annoying but there was plenty of seating Small duty free shop available Toilets were in working order and did not smell Once past security there is nothing but chairs and a toilet Overall it really is not a bad airport The worst part is dealing with the people that want to carry luggage for a tip but that is common in Africa

Presidente Nicolau Lobato Airport is the only international airport in the nation of Timor Leste East Timor It is located about km from the CBD of the capital of Dili Typically there are about five or six international flights per day connecting Dili with Singapore Bali and Darwin It is a very small airport I arrived from and departed to Darwin which meant that there was only one plane with a relatively low passenger capacity seats at the airport The airport was able to easily cope with this I suspect when two As are in at the same time it is a lot more congested On arrival there is a short walk across the terminal to a covered walkway leading to the terminal building The first queue is to purchase an on arrival visa for visitors this costs USD which must be paid for in cash No credit card So bring your exact amount in US Dollars with you Having purchased your visa you then queue to go through passport control Once your passport is stamped only a few steps to a small baggage carousel which is set on very fast your luggage will just about fly off the carousel due to the centrifugal forces Then another short queue to go through customs and quarantines This is all sort of airconditioned and the officials are polite but not exhibiting the charm and welcome that the East Timorese are rightly renowned for Another twenty or so metres takes you to the taxi rank no more than USD to go into town When I was there the queues were very short and we were out of the airport within about twenty minutes Would be longer if bigger planes were arriving and departing On departure through an unmarked door which looks like the entrance to a shop First your bags are xrayed and then you go into a relatively small room which contains the checkin counters then fill in departure card and go through outwards passport control and security There are a couple of small duty free and handicraft shops and a small cafe but no lounges The departure lounge is airconditioned and more than large enough for our flight Then out along the covered walkway and a short walk across the tarmac to the plane Summary a small airport and quite efficient and sufficient for the flights to and from Darwin

We were pressed for time so we didnt stop and eat our plane was scheduled to leave at pm We arrived an hour and minutes early but nothing was open except a place across from gate E and they only had drinks and chips I realize there is a labor shortage but if you look at the chart that depicts the busiest time at this airport pm is the busiest Wouldnt you think that would be the best time to schedule staff

Dusseldorf to Sharm el Sheikh I checked in at in the morning and the line was already very long There were two check in counters for the flight but only one was open It took nearly half an hour until the second staff member came and opened the second counter When I got to the counter to check myself in the check in staff informed me that the aircraft type had changed and that the seat that I had paid extra for was not available anymore as it did not exist on this aircraft type An A was the original planned aircraft but a A was actually being used for this flight So I told the staff member to provide me with a similar seat somewhere else on the aircraft According to her she gave me a seat with extra legroom as I am over meters tall that is what I always need and that is what I had paid for When I got onto the aircraft she had assigned me a normal seat not an extra legroom seat Luckily the plane was only half full and therefore the crew changed me on a extra legroom seat straight away as I could proof that that is what I already had paid for The crew was very friendly and caring The plane arrived on time and I received my luggage very quickly as well

They should be ashamed of the practices the airline is employing to avoid paying compensation at the expense of their customers The staff say is a delay rather than rescheduling when they know they will fly hours later We were flying with a year old child and the call centre firmly told us to be at the airport hours before scheduled time or otherwise we will be considered late because the flight is late rather than rescheduled They knew you will not fly at AM but at PM having delayed the flight a week in advance A disgrace of the company

Africa World Airlines is the worst airline in the world I was supposed to fly from Lagos to Accra on the rd of September but my flight was cancelled without notice I tried to travel again on the th of September but this was also cancelled They have no office in Lagos so I had to drive all the way to the airport every day only to find that they were closed I was finally able to book my flight after paying Naira to one of the airport workers who knew someone who worked there They also require you to pay Naira to take an expensive Covid test before they allow you to board their flights When I reached the airport for travel they refused to check me in because I was wearing a face shield instead of a mask and they made me pay extra to buy a mask from one of the airport shops Then when we arrived in Ghana they charged me another to take another test at the airport there Why cant they just charge one single price for their services instead of advertising one price and then trying to squeeze more money out of their poor customers The Covid tests should also be free for their passengers instead of trying to make even more profit from us who are struggling with reduced income in the pandemic I will never fly with this airline again

The worst airport that I have experienced in years of travel Even worse than airports in developing countries It is dark dirty brown low ceilings no functioning toilets in the gate area there are almost no services food shopping Scarce electrical outlets for recharging There are two souvenir shops and the restaurant was in disarray old uninviting Seating in the gate area is restricted to wooden benches Big s deplane and board from the tarmac It took over minutes for the handicapped and disabled to be hauled up ramps by the one porter on duty Staff were friendly and tried to reassure people but we were late leaving because how long it took them to deplane clean and load people in wheelchairs If you have to fly to Kona plan things so you can spend as little time as possible in the airport I cant understand how a state that prides itself in beauty and tourism would want this airport to be the first thing tourists see or the last thing theyll remember Perhaps there are plans for a new airport to be built and so they are not spending anymore on the old one Who knows But there is no excuse for dirty and a lack of facilities in the gate area
